papers.title: Deeply-Recursive Convolutional Network for Image Super-Resolution

tldr.en: DRCN applies a single convolutional layer recursively, up to 16 recursions, for image super-resolution, adding depth without new parameters; recursive-supervision and skip-connection ease training, and it outperforms previous methods.
tldr.zh: DRCN 在图像超分辨率中递归应用同一个卷积层（最多 16 次递归），加深网络而不增加参数；递归监督和跳跃连接缓解了训练困难，效果超过以往方法。

papers.title: Neural GPUs Learn Algorithms

tldr.en: The Neural GPU repeats shared convolutional GRU layers for n steps on length-n inputs; trained with parameter sharing relaxation on up to 20-bit numbers, it adds and multiplies much longer binary numbers without errors.
tldr.zh: Neural GPU 在长度为 n 的输入上把同一组卷积 GRU 层重复 n 步；借助参数共享松弛在最多 20 比特的数上训练后，它对长得多的二进制数做加法和乘法也没有错误。

papers.title: Adaptive Computation Time for Recurrent Neural Networks

tldr.en: Introduces Adaptive Computation Time, a differentiable halting mechanism that lets an RNN learn how many steps to take per input; it improves performance on four synthetic tasks, while gains on character-level language modelling are small.
tldr.zh: 提出 Adaptive Computation Time（ACT），一种可微的停止机制，让 RNN 学习每个输入要计算多少步；它在四个合成任务上提升了性能，但在字符级语言建模上收益很小。

papers.title: Universal Transformers

tldr.en: Universal Transformer applies the same Transformer block recurrently over depth, with dynamic per-position halting; it is Turing-complete under some assumptions and outperforms standard Transformers on algorithmic and language tasks, gaining 0.9 BLEU on WMT14 En-De.
tldr.zh: Universal Transformer 在深度方向上循环使用同一个 Transformer 块，并按位置动态停止；在一定假设下它是图灵完备的，在算法和语言任务上优于标准 Transformer，在 WMT14 En-De 上提高 0.9 BLEU。

papers.title: Recurrent Stacking of Layers for Compact Neural Machine Translation Models

tldr.en: Shares parameters across all layers of an NMT encoder and decoder; a single layer recurrently stacked 6 times translates comparably to 6 separate layers, and back-translated data improves it further.
tldr.zh: 在 NMT 模型的编码器和解码器中让所有层共享参数；把单层循环堆叠 6 次的翻译质量与 6 个独立层相当，加入回译数据后进一步提升。

papers.title: Deep Equilibrium Models

tldr.en: DEQ finds the fixed point of a weight-tied layer by root-finding and backpropagates through it implicitly; on language modeling such as WikiText-103 it often beats similar-size models while cutting memory by up to 88%.
tldr.zh: DEQ 通过求根直接求出权重共享层的不动点，并用隐式微分反传；在 WikiText-103 等语言建模任务上，它常常优于参数量相近的模型，内存最多减少 88%。

papers.title: ALBERT: A Lite BERT for Self-supervised Learning of Language Representations

tldr.en: ALBERT reduces BERT's parameters with a factorized embedding and cross-layer parameter sharing, adds an inter-sentence coherence loss, and sets new state-of-the-art results on GLUE, RACE and SQuAD with fewer parameters than BERT-large.
tldr.zh: ALBERT 用因式分解的词嵌入和跨层参数共享减少 BERT 的参数量，并加入句间连贯性损失；它以少于 BERT-large 的参数在 GLUE、RACE 和 SQuAD 上取得新的最好结果。

papers.title: Neural Execution of Graph Algorithms

tldr.en: Trains graph neural networks to imitate each step of classical graph algorithms by repeating an encode-process-decode network with a learned termination network; max-based message passing works best, and learning reachability alongside improves shortest-path learning.
tldr.zh: 训练图神经网络逐步模仿经典图算法，每一步重复同一个 encode-process-decode 网络并由学到的终止网络决定何时停止；基于最大值聚合的消息传递效果最好，同时学习可达性任务能改进最短路径算法的学习。

papers.title: Addressing Some Limitations of Transformers with Feedback Memory

tldr.en: Feedback Transformer makes every layer attend to per-timestep memory vectors that mix all layers' past representations, exposing high-level past states to low layers; small, shallow models beat comparable Transformers on language modeling, translation and RL.
tldr.zh: Feedback Transformer 让每一层都关注逐时间步的记忆向量，该向量由各层过去的表示加权求和得到，使低层也能看到过去的高层表示；小而浅的模型在语言建模、机器翻译和强化学习上优于可比的 Transformer。

papers.title: RAFT: Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms for Optical Flow

tldr.en: RAFT builds all-pairs 4D correlation volumes and iteratively updates a flow field with a weight-tied recurrent update operator; it reaches 5.10% F1-all error on KITTI and 2.855 pixels end-point error on Sintel (final pass).
tldr.zh: RAFT 为光流任务构建全像素对的 4D 相关体，并用权重共享的循环更新算子反复更新光流场；在 KITTI 上 F1-all 误差为 5.10%，在 Sintel（final pass）上端点误差为 2.855 像素。

papers.title: Monotone operator equilibrium networks

tldr.en: Introduces monDEQ, an implicit-depth model built on monotone operator theory whose parameterization guarantees a unique equilibrium, solved with operator-splitting methods that converge stably; it outperforms Neural ODE-based models while being more computationally efficient.
tldr.zh: 提出 monDEQ，一种基于单调算子理论的隐式深度模型，其参数化保证唯一平衡点存在，并用稳定收敛的算子分裂方法求解；它优于基于 Neural ODE 的模型，且计算效率更高。

papers.title: Multiscale Deep Equilibrium Models

tldr.en: MDEQ solves for and backpropagates through the equilibrium points of several feature resolutions at once, using implicit differentiation with O(1) memory; on ImageNet classification and Cityscapes segmentation it matches or exceeds competitive vision models.
tldr.zh: MDEQ 借助隐式微分同时求解多个特征分辨率的平衡点并对其反传，只需 O(1) 内存；在 ImageNet 分类和 Cityscapes 语义分割上达到或超过有竞争力的视觉模型。

papers.title: Subformer: Exploring Weight Sharing for Parameter Efficiency in Generative Transformers

tldr.en: Subformer shares parameters across the central layers of generative Transformers, with unshared first and last layers and self-attentive factorized embeddings; it can beat the Transformer on translation, summarization and language modeling with fewer parameters.
tldr.zh: Subformer 在生成式 Transformer 中让中间各层共享参数，首尾两层不共享，并使用自注意力式的分解 embedding；在机器翻译、摘要和语言建模上，它能以更少的参数超过 Transformer。

papers.title: On the Theory of Implicit Deep Learning: Global Convergence with Implicit Layers

tldr.en: For deep equilibrium models with nonlinearity only on weights, proves that gradient dynamics reach a global optimum at a linear rate without width assumptions, and relates them to trust region Newton on a shallow layer.
tldr.zh: 针对只在权重上有非线性的深度均衡模型，证明其梯度动力学不需要宽度假设就能以线性速率收敛到全局最优，并把这一动力学与浅层显式层上的信赖域牛顿法联系起来。

papers.title: Perceiver: General Perception with Iterative Attention

tldr.en: Perceiver repeatedly cross-attends from a small latent array to large inputs, with weights shared across repeats after the first, like an RNN unrolled in depth; it is competitive across images, point clouds, audio and video.
tldr.zh: Perceiver 用一个小的隐变量数组反复对大规模输入做 cross-attention，除第一次外各次重复共享权重，相当于沿深度展开的 RNN；它在图像、点云、音频和视频上都有竞争力。

papers.title: Can You Learn an Algorithm? Generalizing from Easy to Hard Problems with Recurrent Networks

tldr.en: Trains weight-tied recurrent networks with few iterations on easy prefix-sum, maze and chess problems and shows that running extra iterations at test time lets them solve harder instances.
tldr.zh: 用较少的迭代次数在简单的前缀和、迷宫和国际象棋问题上训练权重共享的循环网络，发现测试时增加迭代次数即可解出更难的实例。

papers.title: PonderNet: Learning to Ponder

tldr.en: PonderNet runs a step function recurrently with a learned probabilistic halting policy; it outperforms earlier adaptive-computation methods on parity, succeeds at extrapolation, and matches state-of-the-art bAbI accuracy with less compute.
tldr.zh: PonderNet 循环调用同一个 step function，并端到端学习概率化的停止策略；在 parity 任务上优于以往的自适应计算方法并能外推，在 bAbI 上以更少的计算达到当时的最优水平。

papers.title: Semantic Communication with Adaptive Universal Transformer

tldr.en: Uses Universal Transformers with adaptive computation time halting as encoder and decoder of a semantic communication system; it reports higher BLEU and lower symbol error ratio than a fixed-depth Transformer system on noisy channels.
tldr.zh: 把带自适应计算时间（ACT）停止机制的 Universal Transformer 用作语义通信系统的编码器和解码器；在有噪声的信道上，它的 BLEU 高于固定深度的 Transformer 系统，符号错误率也更低。

papers.title: Sliced Recursive Transformer

tldr.en: SReT shares weights across depth in vision transformers by looping each block; naive recursion gives a ~2% gain, and sliced group self-attention across recursions cuts the added cost by 10~30% with minimal performance loss.
tldr.zh: SReT 通过循环执行每个块在视觉 Transformer 的深度上共享权重；朴素递归带来 ~2% 的提升，跨递归的切片分组自注意力把额外开销降低 10~30%，性能损失很小。

papers.title: End-to-end Algorithm Synthesis with Recurrent Networks: Logical Extrapolation Without Overthinking

tldr.en: Adds recall, which feeds the input into every iteration of a recurrent block, and a progressive loss over random iteration counts; together they prevent overthinking and let networks trained on small problems solve larger ones.
tldr.zh: 提出 recall 结构，把输入拼接到循环块每次迭代的输入中，并用随机迭代次数的渐进式损失训练；二者共同避免 overthinking，使在小问题上训练的网络能解更大的问题。

papers.title: Path Independent Equilibrium Models Can Better Exploit Test-Time Computation

tldr.en: In equilibrium models, upward generalization to harder instances with more test-time iterations correlates with path independence (reaching the same fixed point from any initialization); promoting it improves generalization and penalizing it degrades it.
tldr.zh: 在均衡模型中，用更多测试时迭代向更难实例泛化的能力与路径无关性（从任意初始化都收敛到同一不动点）相关；提升路径无关性能改善泛化，惩罚它则会变差。

papers.title: Looped Transformers as Programmable Computers

tldr.en: Shows that a looped 13-layer transformer with programmed weights, reading instructions and memory from its input, emulates a small instruction-set computer and runs a calculator, linear algebra routines and in-context learning algorithms.
tldr.zh: 证明一个权重经过编程设定的循环 13 层 transformer 能从输入中读取指令和内存，模拟一台小型指令集计算机，并运行计算器、线性代数例程和 in-context learning 算法。

papers.title: Sparse Universal Transformer

tldr.en: Adds sparse mixture-of-experts and stick-breaking dynamic halting to the Universal Transformer, matching strong baselines on WMT'14 with half the computation and parameters; halting saves around 50% inference computation on formal language tasks with little loss.
tldr.zh: 在 Universal Transformer 中加入稀疏 MoE 和基于 stick-breaking 的动态停止机制，在 WMT'14 上以一半的计算量和参数量达到强基线水平；停止机制在形式语言任务上节省约 50% 的推理计算，性能下降很小。

papers.title: CoTFormer: A Chain-of-Thought Driven Architecture with Budget-Adaptive Computation Cost at Inference

tldr.en: CoTFormer re-applies the same layers several times and lets each pass attend to tokens from earlier passes, like chain-of-thought; it approaches much larger models, and a token-wise adaptive-depth variant cuts compute without losing accuracy.
tldr.zh: CoTFormer 多次重复应用同一组层，并像 chain-of-thought 一样让每一遍都能关注前几遍产生的 token；准确率接近大得多的模型，按 token 自适应深度的变体能在不损失准确率的情况下降低计算成本。

papers.title: Looped Transformers are Better at Learning Learning Algorithms

tldr.en: Trains a looped transformer with input injection to solve in-context data-fitting problems such as linear regression; it performs comparably to a standard transformer while using less than 10% of the parameters.
tldr.zh: 训练带输入注入的循环 Transformer，在上下文中求解线性回归等数据拟合问题；其表现与标准 Transformer 相当，参数量不到后者的 10%。

papers.title: Simulation of Graph Algorithms with Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Proves by construction that a looped transformer with extra graph-reading attention heads simulates BFS, DFS, Dijkstra and Kosaraju's algorithm with parameters independent of graph size, within finite-precision limits, and is Turing complete at constant width.
tldr.zh: 通过构造证明，带额外读图注意力头的循环 Transformer 能以与图大小无关的参数量模拟 BFS、DFS、Dijkstra 和 Kosaraju 算法，但受有限精度限制，并且在常数宽度下图灵完备。

papers.title: MoEUT: Mixture-of-Experts Universal Transformers

tldr.en: MoEUT is a shared-layer Transformer with mixture-of-experts feedforward and attention layers, layer grouping and peri-layernorm; it slightly outperforms standard Transformers on language modeling tasks such as BLiMP and PIQA using less compute and memory.
tldr.zh: MoEUT 是在前馈层和注意力层都使用 MoE 的共享层 Transformer，并采用层分组和 peri-layernorm 方案；它在 BLiMP、PIQA 等语言建模任务上略优于标准 Transformer，同时计算和内存更少。

papers.title: Looped Transformers for Length Generalization

tldr.en: Trains looped decoder-only Transformers on tasks with known iterative RASP-L solutions, supervising only the final answer after an input-dependent number of steps; adapting the step count at test time improves length generalization.
tldr.zh: 在有已知迭代 RASP-L 解法的任务上训练循环 decoder-only Transformer，只在与输入相关的步数之后监督最终答案；测试时按输入调整循环步数可以改善长度泛化。

papers.title: On Expressive Power of Looped Transformers: Theoretical Analysis and Enhancement via Timestep Encoding

tldr.en: Derives approximation rates for looped Transformers, revealing a limitation specific to looping, and adds per-loop scaling parameters conditioned on timestep encoding; in experiments more loops improve performance and timestep encoding adds further gains.
tldr.zh: 推导循环 Transformer 的逼近速率，揭示循环结构特有的局限，并据此加入以时间步编码为条件的每遍缩放参数；实验中循环次数越多效果越好，时间步编码带来进一步提升。

papers.title: Can Looped Transformers Learn to Implement Multi-step Gradient Descent for In-context Learning?

tldr.en: Proves that for in-context linear regression, the global minimizer of a linear looped Transformer's training loss implements multi-step preconditioned gradient descent, and that gradient flow converges fast despite non-convexity; synthetic experiments agree.
tldr.zh: 证明在 in-context 线性回归中，线性循环 Transformer 总体训练损失的全局最小点实现了多步预条件梯度下降，且尽管损失非凸，梯度流仍能快速收敛；合成实验与理论一致。

papers.title: Relaxed Recursive Transformers: Effective Parameter Sharing with Layer-wise LoRA

tldr.en: Converts pretrained LLMs into Recursive Transformers that loop one shared block, optionally relaxed with depth-wise LoRA; recursive Gemma 1B beats TinyLlama 1.1B, Pythia 1B and distillation baselines and recovers most of Gemma 2B's performance.
tldr.zh: 把预训练 LLM 转换为循环复用同一组共享层的 Recursive Transformer，并可用逐深度 LoRA 放松权重共享；recursive Gemma 1B 优于 TinyLlama 1.1B、Pythia 1B 和知识蒸馏基线，并恢复了原始 Gemma 2B 的大部分性能。

papers.title: Training Large Language Models to Reason in a Continuous Latent Space

tldr.en: Coconut feeds the last hidden state back as the next input embedding rather than decoding it into a token; these continuous thoughts can encode alternative next steps, and Coconut outperforms CoT on search-heavy logical reasoning.
tldr.zh: Coconut 不把最后的隐藏状态解码成 token，而是直接作为下一个输入 embedding 送回模型；这种连续思维可以编码多个候选的下一步，Coconut 在需要大量搜索的逻辑推理任务上优于 CoT。

papers.title: Scaling up Test-Time Compute with Latent Reasoning: A Recurrent Depth Approach

note.en: Huginn-0125 has 8 distinct layers in a (2,4,2) layout with hidden size 5280 and 55 heads of size 96. The core starts with an adapter that maps the concatenation of the state and the prelude output from 2h to h, and the first state is random noise. At r=32 the model unrolls to 132 effective layers. Small ablation models use (1,4,1) with h=1024.
note.zh: Huginn-0125 共 8 个不同的层，布局 (2,4,2)，hidden size 5280，55 个 96 维的 head。核心块开头的 adapter 把状态和 prelude 输出的拼接从 2h 映射到 h，初始状态是随机噪声。r=32 时展开为 132 层。小规模消融模型用 (1,4,1)，h=1024。

baseline.en: A fixed-depth twin with the same architecture, data and training setup that passes through the core block once, trained for 180B tokens (256 nodes, batch size 2 per GPU).
baseline.zh: 同架构、同数据、同训练设置的固定深度孪生模型，只过一遍核心块，训练 180B token（256 个节点，每张 GPU batch size 2）。

headline.en: The 3.5B model trained on 800B tokens improves on reasoning benchmarks as test-time recurrence grows, up to a computation load equivalent to 50B parameters. At 180B tokens and r=32 it scores 9.02/10.24 on GSM8K CoT against 1.82/2.20 for the fixed-depth twin, which the paper calls 5 times better.
headline.zh: 800B token 训练的 3.5B 模型，测试时循环次数越多，推理类基准越好，算力最多相当于 50B 参数的模型。180B token 时，r=32 的 GSM8K CoT 为 9.02/10.24，固定深度孪生模型为 1.82/2.20，论文称是基线的 5 倍。

results.setting: 3.5B parameters, both models at 180B tokens (0.18T), same data and setup

note.en: GSM8K CoT pairs are copied as printed; the Table 2 caption says the paper reports flexible and strict extract.
note.zh: GSM8K CoT 的两个数照原文抄录；Table 2 标题说明报告的是 flexible 和 strict extract。

results.setting: Huginn-0125 (3.5B, 800B tokens), lm-eval zero-shot at different test-time recurrences r

note.en: arXiv v1 printed different values in the r=4, 8 and 16 rows of Table 1; these are the v2 values.
note.zh: arXiv v1 的 Table 1 中 r=4、8、16 三行数值与此不同；这里用 v2 的数值。

results.setting: Huginn-0125 at r=32 next to fixed-depth open models
Huginn-0125, first-turn MT-Bench, inference schemes used zero-shot

note.en: s is the per-token KV-cache budget in recurrence steps. The paper states no difference from the baseline is statistically significant.
note.zh: s 是每个 token 的 KV cache 预算（递归步数）。论文说明与基线的差异都不显著。

findings.en: Evaluated with one recurrence, the model barely changes between the 180B and 800B checkpoints (ARC-C 23.72 and 24.06); the authors conclude that later gains sit in the recurrent iterations, not in the prelude or coda.
findings.zh: 只跑 1 次循环时，180B 和 800B 两个 checkpoint 几乎没有差别（ARC-C 23.72 和 24.06）；作者据此认为后续提升来自循环迭代，而不在 prelude 或 coda。

findings.en: Useful depth depends on task and context. HellaSwag is near its peak at 8 recurrences; ARC-C saturates around 8-12 iterations with no few-shot examples, around 20 with 1 example and around 32 with 25-50 examples.
findings.zh: 有用的迭代次数取决于任务和上下文。HellaSwag 在 8 次左右接近峰值；ARC-C 没有 few-shot 示例时约 8-12 次饱和，1 个示例时约 20 次，25-50 个示例时约 32 次。

findings.en: Tested at r=64 (training mean 32), an EMA of the last 75 checkpoints reaches 47.23% flexible (38.59% strict) on GSM8K.
findings.zh: 在 r=64（训练均值为 32）下测试，最后 75 个 checkpoint 的 EMA 在 GSM8K 上达到 47.23%（flexible）/ 38.59%（strict）。

findings.en: In ablations, a core block that takes the step index as input interacted badly with path independence and gave models that cannot extrapolate; adding noise at each step did not help.
findings.zh: 消融中，以步数为输入的核心块破坏了路径无关性，得到的模型无法外推；每步加噪声也没有帮助。

findings.en: Two earlier large-scale runs failed. In one, all tokens collapsed to the same hidden state; in the other, the model learned to ignore the recurrent state, with the same validation perplexity at 1 or 32 recurrences. The successful run used sandwich norms and a peak learning rate of 4×10^-5.
findings.zh: 此前两次大规模训练失败。一次所有 token 坍缩成相同的隐状态；另一次模型学会忽略循环状态，1 次和 32 次循环的验证 perplexity 相同。成功的那次用 sandwich 归一化，峰值学习率 4×10^-5。

tldr.en: Pretrain a 3.5B prelude-core-coda transformer with a randomly sampled number of core iterations, so test-time compute scales by iterating the core more.
tldr.zh: 用随机采样的核心块迭代次数预训练 3.5B 的 prelude-core-coda Transformer，测试时多迭代核心块即可增加算力。

problem.en: Mainstream reasoning models scale test-time compute by generating more tokens in long chains of thought, which needs specialized training data and long context windows. The paper scales compute by iterating a recurrent block in latent space instead.
problem.zh: 主流推理模型靠生成更多 token（长 CoT）增加测试时算力，需要专门的训练数据和长上下文窗口。本文改为在隐空间反复迭代一个循环块来增加算力。

en: Split a decoder-only transformer into a prelude, a weight-shared recurrent core and a coda. At every iteration the core receives the prelude output through an adapter on concat(state, prelude output); the first state is random.
Sample the iteration count from a log-normal Poisson distribution with mean 32 (one count per micro-batch, synchronized across workers) and backpropagate through only the last 8 iterations.

Train once at (2,4,2) with h=5280 on 800B tokens of public data weighted toward code and math, on 4096 AMD MI250X GPUs, with sandwich normalization (four RMSNorms per layer) and a scaled initialization.
At inference the iteration count is free; the paper also tries zero-shot per-token early exit, KV-cache sharing, continuous-CoT warm starts and self-speculative decoding.
zh: 把 decoder-only Transformer 分成 prelude、权重共享的循环核心块和 coda。每次迭代，核心块通过对 concat(状态, prelude 输出) 的 adapter 接收 prelude 输出；初始状态随机。
迭代次数从均值 32 的 log-normal Poisson 分布采样（每个 micro-batch 一个值，各 worker 同步），只反传最后 8 次迭代。
以 (2,4,2)、h=5280 的形状，在 4096 张 AMD MI250X 上用 800B token 的公开数据（偏重代码和数学）训练一次，采用 sandwich 归一化（每层四个 RMSNorm）和缩放初始化。
推理时迭代次数可自由设定；论文还零样本尝试了逐 token 提前退出、KV cache 共享、连续 CoT 热启动和自推测解码。

en: A single large run with 3.5B parameters and 800B tokens, on a data mixture the authors could not ablate and with a constant learning rate that was never cooled down (47000 steps).
The looped-vs-fixed-depth comparison exists only at 180B tokens. It matches parameters and tokens but not compute, since the baseline passes through the core once.
The comparisons with Amber, Pythia, OLMo and StarCoder2 models (Tables 1-3) are not matched in parameters, tokens or data.
Training uses 4096-token sequences and backpropagates through only the last 8 core iterations.

Early exit, KV-cache sharing and continuous CoT are zero-shot uses of a model not trained for them, measured only on first-turn MT-Bench, where the differences are not statistically significant (Table 6). Self-speculative decoding has no reported measurements.
zh: 只训练了一个大模型，3.5B 参数、800B token；数据配比作者没能做消融，学习率一直是常数、没有退火（47000 step）。
循环与固定深度的对比只在 180B token 处做过；对齐了参数和 token，没对齐算力，基线只过一遍核心块。
与 Amber、Pythia、OLMo、StarCoder2 等模型的对比（Table 1-3）在参数、token 和数据上都没有对齐。

papers.title: Inner Thinking Transformer: Leveraging Dynamic Depth Scaling to Foster Adaptive Internal Thinking

tldr.en: ITT turns every other layer into a looped layer whose learned routers send selected tokens through extra steps of the same layer, accumulated by residual thinking connections; with 162M parameters it reaches 96.5% of a 466M Transformer's performance, saves 43.2% of training data and beats Transformer and Loop variants on 11 benchmarks.
tldr.zh: ITT 把每隔一层换成循环层，由学到的路由器挑出 token 在同一层上多算几步，再用 Residual Thinking Connection 累加各步结果；162M 的 ITT 达到 466M Transformer 96.5% 的性能，训练数据省 43.2%，在 11 个基准上超过 Transformer 和 Loop 变体。

papers.title: Reasoning with Latent Thoughts: On the Power of Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Shows that a k-layer transformer looped L times nearly matches a kL-layer model on synthetic reasoning and is competitive on language-model reasoning tasks, and proves T loops can simulate T steps of CoT.
tldr.zh: 表明 k 层 Transformer 循环 L 次在合成推理任务上接近 kL 层模型，在语言模型的下游推理任务上也能与之竞争，并证明 T 次循环可以模拟 T 步 CoT。

papers.title: CODI: Compressing Chain-of-Thought into Continuous Space via Self-Distillation

tldr.en: CODI jointly trains explicit-CoT teacher and implicit-CoT student tasks, aligning a designated token's hidden states to compress CoT into continuous space; at GPT-2 scale it matches explicit CoT on GSM8k with 3.1x compression.
tldr.zh: CODI 联合训练显式 CoT 教师任务和隐式 CoT 学生任务，通过对齐指定 token 的隐藏状态把 CoT 压缩到连续空间；在 GPT-2 规模上它在 GSM8k 上追平显式 CoT，压缩率为 3.1x。

papers.title: A Little Depth Goes a Long Way: The Expressive Power of Log-Depth Transformers

tldr.en: Proves that looped transformers repeating middle layers Θ(log n) times recognize regular languages and solve graph connectivity, which fixed-depth transformers cannot under standard conjectures; growing depth is more efficient than growing width or chain-of-thought steps.
tldr.zh: 证明中间层重复 Θ(log n) 次的循环 transformer 能识别正则语言并求解图连通性，而在标准复杂性猜想下固定深度 transformer 做不到；增加深度比增加宽度或 chain-of-thought 步数更高效。

papers.title: PonderLM: Pretraining Language Models to Ponder in Continuous Space

tldr.en: PonderLM feeds the probability-weighted sum of token embeddings back into the same model for several forward passes per token, learned by self-supervised pretraining; PonderPythia-2.8B surpasses Pythia-6.9B and rivals Pythia-12B.
tldr.zh: PonderLM 在预测每个 token 时，把按预测分布加权的 token 嵌入之和加回输入，再送入同一个模型做下一次前向，并通过自监督预训练学会这种思考；PonderPythia-2.8B 超过 Pythia-6.9B，并与 Pythia-12B 相当。

papers.title: Hierarchical Reasoning Model

tldr.en: HRM couples a slow high-level and a fast low-level recurrent module; with 27 million parameters and 1000 training samples, it nearly solves complex Sudoku and large mazes and beats larger models on ARC.
tldr.zh: HRM 把慢速的高层循环模块和快速的低层循环模块耦合在一起；只用 27M 参数和 1000 个训练样本，就在复杂 Sudoku 和大型迷宫上接近完美，并在 ARC 上超过更大的模型。

papers.title: Energy-Based Transformers are Scalable Learners and Thinkers

tldr.en: Energy-Based Transformers predict by gradient descent on a learned energy over input-prediction pairs; versus Transformer++, they show up to 35% higher training scaling rate and 29% more gain from System 2 Thinking on language tasks.
tldr.zh: Energy-Based Transformer 学习输入与候选预测之间的能量，通过对能量做梯度下降来给出预测；与 Transformer++ 相比，训练时的 scaling 速率最高高出 35%，在语言任务上 System 2 Thinking 带来的提升多 29%。

note.en: Middle-Cycle sharing on a Llama-style model keeps the first and last layers unique and applies one shared block up to Nr times (360M base with Nr=3 uses 1+10+1 unique layers; Nr=2 uses 1+15+1). Routers decide how many recursions each token gets. Expert-choice keeps the top-k tokens at each step (3/3, 2/3 and 1/3 of the tokens for Nr=3), and only tokens kept at step r can be kept at r+1; token-choice assigns each token its depth once. The router score scales the block output that is added to the residual. Each step caches KV only for its active tokens and attends only among them; a variant reuses the first recursion's KV at every step.
note.zh: 在 Llama 式模型上用 Middle-Cycle 共享：首尾两层独立，中间一个共享块最多重复 Nr 次（360M 基座、Nr=3 时为 1+10+1 个独立层；Nr=2 为 1+15+1）。由路由器决定每个 token 递归几次。expert-choice 每步保留 top-k token（Nr=3 时依次为 3/3、2/3、1/3），只有第 r 步被保留的 token 才能在第 r+1 步再被选中；token-choice 一开始就给每个 token 定好深度。路由分数缩放共享块的输出，再加回残差。每一步只为仍在计算的 token 存 KV，注意力也只在这些 token 之间计算；另一种变体在每一步都复用第一遍的 KV。

baseline.en: Vanilla Llama-style Transformer (315M non-embedding parameters at the 360M base) and fixed-depth Recursive Transformers with the same Middle-Cycle sharing (Nr=2-4).

At an equal 20B tokens it uses 25% fewer training FLOPs, 19% less training time and 25% less peak memory than vanilla.

findings.en: With unique parameters fixed at 252M (730M base, Nr=3), Middle-Cycle with 1+8+1 layers (26 effective) beats Cycle with 10 layers (30 effective), with NLL 2.7552 vs 2.7573 and average accuracy 42.32 vs 41.90.
findings.zh: 唯一参数固定为 252M（730M 基座，Nr=3）时，1+8+1 层的 Middle-Cycle（26 个有效层）优于 10 层的 Cycle（30 个有效层），NLL 为 2.7552 对 2.7573，平均准确率为 42.32 对 41.90。

findings.en: At the 135M base, Cycle is slightly ahead of Middle-Cycle at Nr=2 (NLL 3.0071 vs 3.0330), while Middle-Cycle leads at Nr=3 and at the 360M base for both depths. In up-training from SmolLM checkpoints, both Middle strategies do better than the others in all settings.

findings.en: At Nr=3, expert-choice routing beats token-choice (42.6% vs 40.0% average accuracy in Table 3). In the 10B-token ablation, recursive KV sharing raises training NLL for expert-choice MoR (2.8667 to 2.8895) but lowers it for token-choice MoR (2.9358 to 2.9155).
findings.zh: Nr=3 时 expert-choice 路由优于 token-choice（Table 3 中平均准确率 42.6% 对 40.0%）。在 10B token 的消融中，recursive KV sharing 让 expert-choice MoR 的训练 NLL 升高（2.8667 到 2.8895），却让 token-choice MoR 的训练 NLL 降低（2.9358 到 2.9155）。

findings.en: With continuous depth-wise batching at the 360M scale, every MoR variant decodes faster than vanilla, and MoR-4 reaches up to a 2.06× speedup at the maximum batch size, with a slight drop in quality.
findings.zh: 在 360M 规模下用 continuous depth-wise batching 解码，所有 MoR 变体都比 vanilla 快，MoR-4 在最大 batch size 下最高提速 2.06×，质量略有下降。

findings.en: Log-likelihood improves as the maximum recursion depth at inference is raised step by step up to the trained Nr (models with Nr=2, 3 and 4 at the 360M base); no run goes beyond the trained Nr.
findings.zh: 推理时把最大递归深度逐步提高到训练时的 Nr，log-likelihood 随之提升（360M 基座，Nr=2、3、4 的模型）；没有实验超过训练时的 Nr。

tldr.en: Routers give each token its own number of passes through a shared middle block, and each pass caches KV only for its active tokens; at equal training FLOPs MoR beats fixed-depth recursive baselines and often vanilla, with fewer parameters.
tldr.zh: 路由器给每个 token 分配穿过共享中段的遍数，每一遍只为仍在计算的 token 存 KV；同等训练 FLOPs 下，MoR 优于固定深度的递归基线，也常优于 vanilla，且参数更少。

problem.en: Efficiency work usually targets either parameter sharing or adaptive computation. Recursive Transformers mostly apply one fixed depth to every token and keep a separate KV cache per depth, while early-exit methods need extra training stages and leave exited tokens without KV at deeper layers.
problem.zh: 提效工作通常只做参数共享或自适应计算之一。递归 Transformer 大多给所有 token 同样的固定深度，每个深度各存一份 KV；early-exit 方法需要额外的训练阶段，而且提前退出的 token 在更深的层没有 KV。

en: Middle-Cycle sharing keeps the first and last layers unique and cycles one shared block of middle layers up to Nr times.

Lightweight routers trained from scratch give each token its own recursion depth. Expert-choice picks the top-k tokens at every step with hierarchical filtering and adds an auxiliary BCE loss so the choice can be made causally at inference; token-choice assigns the depth once and uses a balancing loss.
Recursion-wise caching stores KV at each step only for the tokens routed there and restricts attention to them; recursive KV sharing instead reuses the first step's KV at every step.
Vanilla, fixed-depth recursive and MoR models (135M-1.7B base sizes, FineWeb-Edu, 2K context) are compared at equal training FLOPs (2e18, 5e18, 16.5e18) and at equal tokens (20B).
zh: Middle-Cycle 共享：首尾两层独立，中间层组成一个共享块，最多循环 Nr 次。
从头训练的轻量路由器给每个 token 分配递归深度。expert-choice 每步按层级过滤选出 top-k token，并加辅助 BCE loss，使推理时能按因果方式做选择；token-choice 一开始就定好深度，并用负载均衡 loss。
recursion-wise caching 在每一步只为被路由到该步的 token 存 KV，注意力也只在这些 token 之间计算；recursive KV sharing 则在每一步都复用第一步的 KV。
在相同训练 FLOPs（2e18、5e18、16.5e18）和相同 token（20B）下比较 vanilla、固定深度递归和 MoR 模型（基座 135M-1.7B，FineWeb-Edu，2K 上下文）。

en: Models go up to a 1.7B base (0.67B-0.87B unique non-embedding parameters for MoR) with 2K context, are trained only on FineWeb-Edu and are evaluated by NLL and six few-shot benchmarks; the authors leave models above 3B to future work (Section 7.1).
The main comparison fixes training FLOPs, not parameters or tokens; MoR has fewer unique parameters and sees more tokens (27B-31B against 20B in Table 3).
FLOPs are approximate forward-pass counts that leave out FlashAttention, normalization and non-linearities, and token-choice FLOPs assume perfect balancing (Appendix D).
At the 135M base, and at the 1.7B base with 68.5e18 FLOPs, vanilla beats MoR (Section 3.2; Appendix C.1).

Expert-choice top-k selection is non-causal during training; inference relies on an auxiliary loss to predict it, and the near-binary router outputs make top-k hard to change after training (Section 2.2.1; Section 7.1).
Throughput is measured only at the 360M scale, generating from an empty prefix, and excludes the time spent caching and updating KV (Appendix E).
Vanilla, recursive and MoR runs share one set of optimizer settings (learning rate 3e-3 in the released 360M configs); the paper reports no separate tuning.
zh: 模型最大到 1.7B 基座（MoR 的唯一非 embedding 参数为 0.67B-0.87B），2K 上下文，只用 FineWeb-Edu 训练，只评测 NLL 和六个 few-shot 基准；作者把 3B 以上的模型留作后续工作（Section 7.1）。
主要对比对齐了训练 FLOPs，没对齐参数和 token：MoR 唯一参数更少，看到的 token 更多（Table 3 中 27B-31B 对 20B）。
FLOPs 是近似的前向计算量，不含 FlashAttention、归一化和非线性运算，token-choice 的 FLOPs 按完美负载均衡估算（Appendix D）。
135M 基座时，以及 1.7B 基座、68.5e18 FLOPs 时，vanilla 都优于 MoR（Section 3.2；Appendix C.1）。
expert-choice 的 top-k 选择在训练时不满足因果性；推理时靠辅助 loss 来预测，而路由输出几乎是二值的，训练后很难再改 top-k（Section 2.2.1；Section 7.1）。
吞吐只在 360M 规模上测，从空前缀开始生成，不计缓存和更新 KV 的时间（Appendix E）。
vanilla、递归和 MoR 共用一套优化器设置（公开的 360M 配置里学习率都是 3e-3）；论文没有提到单独调参。

papers.title: Parallel Loop Transformer for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling

note.en: Each loop runs the whole stack with tied weights. Before every non-first loop, the previous loop's last-layer states are shifted right by one token and added to the token embeddings, so at decoding time loop l of token i runs in the same forward pass as loop l+1 of token i-1. Non-first loops attend globally to the first loop's KV and locally to their own KV through SWA (w=64), mixed by a head-wise sigmoid gate. The in-house Seed-MoE layer count is not disclosed; the open-source OLMo/OLMoE runs use 16 layers (Appendix A.2.1).
note.zh: 每一遍都跑整个模型，权重共享。每个非首遍之前，把上一遍最后一层的输出右移一个 token，再加上 token embedding，所以解码时 token i 的第 l 遍和 token i-1 的第 l+1 遍在同一次前向里执行。非首遍对首遍的 KV 做全局注意力，对自己的 KV 做窗口 w=64 的 SWA，两者用按 head 的 sigmoid 门控混合。内部 Seed-MoE 的层数未公开；开源 OLMo/OLMoE 实验用 16 层（Appendix A.2.1）。

findings.zh: 参数相同时三遍好于两遍，PLT-3 平均精度 40.8，PLT-2 为 39.7；Table 2 中两者延迟为 5.0 和 4.9 ms，KV 为 287M 和 284M。

findings.en: At batch sizes 32 and 64, PLT-2 cuts per-token decoding latency by 47% relative to the vanilla two-loop model and runs at 1.06× and 1.04× the latency of the unlooped model.
findings.zh: batch size 为 32 和 64 时，PLT-2 的每 token 解码延迟比普通两遍循环低 47%，分别是不循环模型的 1.06 倍和 1.04 倍。

findings.en: A PLT-2 with two-thirds of the baseline's layers (1.7B/40B) averages 62.6 against 62.1 for the 2.5B/60B Seed-MoE, with about 30% lower decoding latency.
findings.zh: 层数为基线三分之二的 PLT-2（1.7B/40B）平均 62.6，2.5B/60B 的 Seed-MoE 为 62.1，PLT-2 解码延迟约低 30%。

tldr.en: Run loop l of token i in the same forward pass as loop l+1 of token i-1, let later loops reuse the first loop's KV plus a gated SWA, and a looped model decodes at close to unlooped latency and KV.
tldr.zh: 让 token i 的第 l 遍和 token i-1 的第 l+1 遍在同一次前向里执行，后续遍复用首遍 KV 并加门控 SWA，循环模型的解码延迟和 KV 接近不循环模型。

problem.en: In a vanilla looped Transformer the loops run one after another, so per-token compute, decoding latency and KV cache all grow linearly with the number of loops.
problem.zh: 普通循环 Transformer 的各遍依次串行执行，每 token 计算、解码延迟和 KV 都随遍数线性增长。

en: Cross-loop parallelism (CLP) shifts the previous loop's last-layer states right by one token and adds the embeddings before each non-first loop, so loop l of token i, loop l+1 of token i-1 and so on are decoded as one micro-batch in a single forward pass.
Non-first loops keep their own queries but attend globally to the first loop's KV, so only one global KV cache is stored.

Gated SWA (G-SWA) lets non-first loops also attend to their own KV within a 64-token window and mixes local and global outputs through a head-wise sigmoid gate; these loops cache only the most recent w KV entries.
zh: 跨遍并行（CLP）在每个非首遍之前把上一遍最后一层的输出右移一个 token 再加上 embedding，解码时 token i 的第 l 遍、token i-1 的第 l+1 遍等组成一个 micro-batch，在一次前向里算完。
非首遍保留自己的 query，但对首遍的 KV 做全局注意力，所以只需存一份全局 KV。
门控 SWA（G-SWA）让非首遍再在 64 token 的窗口内看自己的 KV，局部和全局输出用按 head 的 sigmoid 门控混合；这些遍只缓存最近 w 个 KV。

en: The main results use in-house Seed-MoE models whose data and other training details are withheld; the open-source OLMo/OLMoE runs (1.2B dense and 1B/7B MoE at 400B tokens, plus a 100B-token dense ablation) test only L=2.
Each model is trained and evaluated at one fixed loop count (L=2 or 3); the paper does not report running a different number of loops at inference.

Parameters and training tokens are matched but compute is not; an L-loop PLT spends L times the per-token compute of the baseline (Table 1), and its latency advantage rests on decoding being memory-bound.
CLP parallelizes decoding only; training stays serial along the loop dimension (Figure 4).
Latency is per-token decoding latency on one GPU with FP8 attention, W4A8 linear layers and a 5000-token prefill; the latency and KV columns of Table 2 are at batch size 4.
Hyperparameters of the in-house runs are not given, so the paper does not say whether the baseline was tuned separately.
zh: 主要结果来自内部 Seed-MoE 模型，数据和其他训练细节未公开；开源的 OLMo/OLMoE 实验（400B token 的 1.2B dense 和 1B/7B MoE，以及 100B token 的 dense 消融）只测了 L=2。
每个模型训练和评测都用同一个固定遍数（L=2 或 3）；论文没有报告推理时换用其他遍数。
对齐了参数和训练 token，没对齐算力；L 遍的 PLT 每 token 计算是基线的 L 倍（Table 1），延迟优势依赖解码受显存带宽限制。
CLP 只让解码并行；训练在遍数维度上仍是串行（Figure 4）。
延迟是单卡上的每 token 解码延迟，attention 用 FP8、线性层用 W4A8，prefill 长度 5000；Table 2 的延迟和 KV 列是 batch size 4 下的值。
内部实验的超参没有给出，论文没说基线是否单独调过。

papers.title: Scaling Latent Reasoning via Looped Language Models

passes.test: 4 by default; the exit gate can stop earlier

note.en: The whole decoder stack loops: Ouro 1.4B repeats its 24 layers and Ouro 2.6B its 48 layers, which were upcycled from the 24 layers by layer duplication; embedding and LM head sit outside the loop. The embedding enters only before the first step, and each step takes the previous step's output. After every step an LM head and an exit gate read the hidden state. Training always runs T_max steps and weights each step's loss by the learned exit distribution. Each step keeps its own KV cache.
note.zh: 整个 decoder 层栈循环：Ouro 1.4B 重复全部 24 层，Ouro 2.6B 重复 48 层（由这 24 层复制 upcycle 而来）；embedding 和 LM head 在循环外。embedding 只在第一步之前输入，之后每一步接上一步的输出。每一步之后由 LM head 和退出门读取隐状态。训练时总是跑满 T_max 步，按学到的退出分布给各步 loss 加权。每一步各存一份 KV。

baseline.en: Public dense base models run through the same evaluation pipeline (Gemma3, Llama3.1/3.2, Qwen2.5 and Qwen3, 1B to 12B); the Thinking models are compared with Qwen3 and DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen.
baseline.zh: 用同一评测流程测试的公开 dense 基座模型（Gemma3、Llama3.1/3.2、Qwen2.5、Qwen3，1B 到 12B）；Thinking 模型对比 Qwen3 和 DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen。

headline.en: Ouro 1.4B R4 (7.7T tokens) matches or beats the 4B Qwen3-Base (36T tokens) on BBH (71.02 vs 70.95), GSM8K (78.92 vs 72.86) and MATH500 (82.40 vs 59.60); Ouro 2.6B R4 scores 55.73 on MMLU-Pro, 80.46 on BBH and 90.85 on MATH500, against 53.72, 77.65 and 62.30 for the 8B Qwen3-Base.
headline.zh: Ouro 1.4B R4（7.7T token）在 BBH（71.02 对 70.95）、GSM8K（78.92 对 72.86）和 MATH500（82.40 对 59.60）上持平或超过 4B 的 Qwen3-Base（36T token）；Ouro 2.6B R4 的 MMLU-Pro、BBH、MATH500 分别为 55.73、80.46、90.85，8B 的 Qwen3-Base 为 53.72、77.65、62.30。

results.setting: Base models; Ouro runs 4 recurrent steps (R4); all models use the same evaluation pipeline (Appendix C.1)
Base models; Ouro runs 4 recurrent steps (R4)
Ouro base models trained with 4 steps, evaluated at T=1-8 (T=5-8 is extrapolation)
Ouro-Thinking models trained with 4 steps, evaluated at T=1-8
Ouro 1.4B, KV cache reuse during decoding only; prefill keeps all four caches

note.en: The paper does not name the model size in Table 14; the project page labels the same table Ouro-1.4B.
note.zh: 论文 Table 14 没写模型规模；项目页把同一张表标为 Ouro-1.4B。

results.setting: Mano task (modular arithmetic answered without intermediate steps); k⊗n is k layers looped n times, and 12⊗1 is the iso-FLOP baseline
results.metric: exact-match accuracy at maximum expression length L=10 / 16 / 24

note.en: Each setting reports the best of 3 random seeds (Appendix B.2).
note.zh: 每个设置报告 3 个随机种子中最好的结果（Appendix B.2）。

findings.en: Training with 8 recurrent steps in Stage 1a led to loss spikes and gradient oscillations, so the authors cut to 4 steps from Stage 1b on.
findings.zh: Stage 1a 用 8 个循环步训练时出现 loss 尖峰和梯度震荡，作者从 Stage 1b 起改为 4 步。

findings.en: The trained depth is not always best for the Thinking models. The 1.4B model scores higher at T=5 than at T=4 on OlympiadBench (72.30 vs 71.55) and SuperGPQA (48.73 vs 47.37), and the 2.6B model peaks at T=3 on AIME 2024 (70.33, against 64.70 at T=4).
findings.zh: Thinking 模型并不总在训练深度上最好：1.4B 在 OlympiadBench（72.30 对 71.55）和 SuperGPQA（48.73 对 47.37）上 T=5 高于 T=4；2.6B 在 AIME 2024 上 T=3 最高（70.33，T=4 为 64.70）。

findings.en: Safety on HEx-PHI improves as the number of recurrent steps grows (tested 1-8), including the extrapolated steps 5-8. At 4 steps the harmful rate is 0.009 for Ouro 1.4B Thinking and 0.003 for Ouro 2.6B Thinking (Qwen3-4B-Thinking 0.009).
findings.zh: HEx-PHI 上的安全性随循环步数增加而改善（测了 1-8 步），外推的第 5-8 步也是如此。4 步时 Ouro 1.4B Thinking 和 2.6B Thinking 的有害率分别为 0.009 和 0.003（Qwen3-4B-Thinking 为 0.009）。

findings.en: On MMLU, the gate with Stage II exit training reaches 66% accuracy at an average of 2.5 exit rounds, against about 64% for the gate from pre-training alone; fixed-depth exit gives 40% at 1 round and 67.35% at 4.
findings.zh: 在 MMLU 上，经过 Stage II 退出训练的门在平均 2.5 步退出时准确率为 66%，只经过预训练的门约为 64%；固定深度退出在 1 步时为 40%，4 步时为 67.35%。

findings.en: Reusing KV caches during prefill costs more than 10 points on GSM8K, so all four steps keep their own KV during prefill.
findings.zh: prefill 阶段复用 KV 会让 GSM8K 下降 10 分以上，所以 prefill 时四步都各存 KV。

findings.en: On the synthetic Capo task, looped (4 steps) and non-looped models with the same parameter count both store about 2 bits of knowledge per parameter.
findings.zh: 在合成的 Capo 任务上，参数量相同的循环模型（4 步）和不循环模型都存下约 2 bit/参数的知识。

findings.en: In 20B-token FineWeb-Edu runs at 53M-1.36B, a Standard model with unshared layers and the same executed depth scores higher than LoopLM in every case, and the gap grows with the step count (in Table 18 the 1.3B gap is 0.017 at 2 steps and 0.025 at 4).
findings.zh: 在 53M-1.36B、20B token FineWeb-Edu 的实验中，执行层数相同但各层不共享的 Standard 模型在所有设置下都高于 LoopLM，差距随步数增大（Table 18 中 1.3B 的差距在 2 步时为 0.017，4 步时为 0.025）。

tldr.en: Pre-train a weight-tied layer stack that repeats 4 times, with a learned exit gate, on 7.7T tokens; the authors report that the 1.4B and 2.6B models match dense models of up to 12B parameters.
tldr.zh: 在 7.7T token 上预训练共享权重、重复 4 遍的层栈，并学习退出门；作者称 1.4B 和 2.6B 模型可比肩最大 12B 参数的 dense 模型。

problem.en: LLMs mostly learn to reason through explicit chain-of-thought added after pre-training. The paper asks whether looping shared layers in latent space, built into pre-training at multi-trillion-token scale, scales better than non-recursive Transformers.
problem.zh: LLM 主要靠预训练之后加入的显式 CoT 来推理。论文研究把共享层的隐空间循环放进数万亿 token 规模的预训练，是否比不循环的 Transformer 扩展得更好。

en: Repeat the whole decoder stack (24 layers for 1.4B, 48 for 2.6B) with shared weights; after every step an LM head computes a loss and an exit gate predicts the probability of stopping.
Stage I minimizes the per-step losses weighted by the gate's exit distribution minus an entropy bonus, which equals a KL term toward a uniform prior over exit steps up to a constant.

Stage II freezes the LM and trains only the gate to continue while the next step still lowers the loss by more than a threshold; at inference the model exits at the first step whose cumulative exit probability reaches q.
Pre-train on 7.7T tokens in four stages (8 steps in Stage 1a, then 4; the 2.6B model is upcycled from the 24-layer model), then run reasoning SFT on about 8.3M examples for the Thinking models.
zh: 整个 decoder 层栈共享权重重复执行（1.4B 为 24 层，2.6B 为 48 层）；每一步之后 LM head 计算 loss，退出门预测停止的概率。
Stage I 最小化按退出分布加权的各步 loss 再减去熵奖励，除一个常数外等价于朝均匀先验的 KL 项。
Stage II 冻结 LM，只训练退出门：下一步还能让 loss 下降超过阈值就继续；推理时在累计退出概率首次达到 q 的那一步退出。
分四个阶段预训练 7.7T token（Stage 1a 用 8 步，之后用 4 步；2.6B 由 24 层模型 upcycle 而来），再用约 8.3M 条数据做推理 SFT 得到 Thinking 模型。

en: The headline comparisons (Tables 7-9) are against separately trained public models that differ in parameters and training tokens (2T-36T); no budget is matched, and Ouro runs its stack 4 times per token.
The models are trained at 4 steps; base benchmark scores are strongest around T=4 and degrade moderately at T=5-8, and the Thinking models degrade at T=6-8 (Tables 10-13).
By default every step keeps its own KV cache (4× memory at 4 steps); last-step-only reuse was tested for decoding only, because prefill needs all four caches (Section 5.4.2).
Reasoning results come from an in-house harness with an LLM judge and temperature 1.0, top_p 0.7 for every model (Section 5.2; Table 17).

Controlled looped-versus-unlooped studies are small; they use synthetic tasks (Capo with 1M-40M GPT-2-style models, Mano, multi-hop QA) and 53M-1.36B models trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens (Section 6; Appendix D).
The authors did not run exhaustive learning-rate sweeps (Section 4.3), and RLVR with DAPO and GRPO did not improve on the SFT checkpoint (Section 4.5).
zh: 主要对比（Tables 7-9）是与独立训练的公开模型比，参数量和训练 token（2T-36T）都不同，没有对齐任何预算；Ouro 每个 token 要把层栈跑 4 遍。
模型按 4 步训练；基座模型的 benchmark 分数在 T=4 附近最好，T=5-8 小幅下降，Thinking 模型在 T=6-8 下降（Tables 10-13）。
默认每一步各存一份 KV（4 步即 4× 显存）；只存末步 KV 的做法只在 decoding 测过，因为 prefill 需要全部四份 KV（Section 5.4.2）。
推理类结果来自内部评测框架，用 LLM 评判，所有模型都用 temperature 1.0、top_p 0.7（Section 5.2；Table 17）。
循环与不循环的受控对比规模都很小：合成任务（Capo 用 1M-40M 的 GPT-2 式模型，Mano，多跳问答）以及在 20B FineWeb-Edu token 上训练的 53M-1.36B 模型（Section 6；Appendix D）。
作者没有做全面的学习率搜索（Section 4.3）；用 DAPO 和 GRPO 做 RLVR 也没有超过 SFT checkpoint（Section 4.5）。

note.en: Shown is TinyLlama (4,8,4); labels are layer indices in the 22-layer TinyLlama-1.1B-3T parent, whose layers 4-9 are dropped. OLMo-2-0425-1B and Llama-3.2-1B use (4,6,4) with layers L0-3, L6-11 and L12-15, dropping L4-5. Sections 4.1-4.2 use a (2,4,2) model built from Llama-3.2-1B. The recurrence count is sampled from a Poisson-Lognormal distribution whose mean follows the curriculum, so depth is both sampled and scheduled.
note.zh: 图示为 TinyLlama (4,8,4)；标签是 22 层父模型 TinyLlama-1.1B-3T 中的层号，第 4-9 层被删掉。OLMo-2-0425-1B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 用 (4,6,4)，取 L0-3、L6-11、L12-15，删掉 L4-5。Section 4.1-4.2 用的是由 Llama-3.2-1B 构造的 (2,4,2)。递归次数从 Poisson-Lognormal 分布采样，分布均值按课程变化，所以深度既是采样的，也按计划递增。

baseline.en: The parent model (TinyLlama, OLMo or Llama) post-trained without recurrence on the same data in the same order. Figures 5-7 compare accuracy against training FLOPs and at the final checkpoint.
baseline.zh: 父模型（TinyLlama、OLMo 或 Llama）不加循环，用相同数据、按相同顺序继续训练。Figure 5-7 按训练 FLOPs 和最终 checkpoint 比较准确率。

headline.en: Converting a pretrained model to a recurrent one gives better math accuracy at a given training compute budget than post-training the non-recurrent model. After the same ~50B math tokens, OLMo (4,6,4) at train and test recurrence 32 scores 51.6 on GSM8K and 29.3 on MATH, against 35.3 and 25.1 for the post-trained non-recurrent OLMo.
headline.zh: 把预训练模型改造成循环模型，在给定训练算力下数学准确率高于直接继续训练非循环模型。用同样约 50B 的数学 token 训练后，训练和测试递归次数都为 32 的 OLMo (4,6,4) 在 GSM8K 和 MATH 上为 51.6 和 29.3，继续训练的非循环 OLMo 为 35.3 和 25.1。

results.setting: TinyLlama-1.1B-3T converted to (4,8,4), about 50B tokens of Nemotron-CC-Math-v1-4plus, test recurrence 32
OLMo-2-0425-1B converted to (4,6,4), same data, test recurrence 32
Llama-3.2-1B converted to (4,6,4), same data, test recurrence 32
TinyLlama (4,8,4) at train recurrence 4. Single phase is 26B tokens of FineWeb-Edu mixed with Nemotron SFT data; two phase first trains on 26B tokens of FineWeb-Edu (52B in total)
(2,4,2) model, about 120B tokens of FineWeb-Edu, mean recurrence 32, zero-shot

findings.en: Linearly ramping the mean recurrence up to 32 slightly lowers validation loss per step and greatly lowers it per training FLOP ((2,4,2) from Llama, 48 hours on 4 MI300A GPUs, about 1e20 FLOPs).
findings.zh: 把平均递归次数线性升到 32，按 step 看验证 loss 略低，按训练 FLOPs 看低很多（Llama 初始化的 (2,4,2)，4 张 MI300A 跑 48 小时，约 1e20 FLOPs）。

findings.en: On GSM8K, larger training recurrences give a larger gain per training FLOP for OLMo and Llama, but not for TinyLlama.
findings.zh: 在 GSM8K 上，OLMo 和 Llama 的训练递归次数越大，每单位训练 FLOP 的提升越大；TinyLlama 不符合这一趋势。

findings.en: A 26B-token FineWeb-Edu healing phase before the mixed data raises the recurrent model's Arc-C by 5% over single-phase training, while the non-recurrent model changes little.
findings.zh: 在混合数据之前先用 26B token 的 FineWeb-Edu 做 healing，循环模型的 Arc-C 比单阶段训练高 5%，非循环模型变化不大。

findings.en: Among the tested layer choices for a (2,4,2) model from Llama-1b, taking early layers for the prelude and later layers for the core and coda gave the lowest training loss; on TinyLlama (4,8,4) this choice also reached lower loss than layers picked with ShortGPT.
findings.zh: 在从 Llama-1b 构造 (2,4,2) 的几种选层方式中，prelude 取前面的层、核心块和 coda 取后面的层，训练 loss 最低；在 TinyLlama (4,8,4) 上，这种选法的 loss 也低于用 ShortGPT 选出的层。

findings.en: Muon trains the recurrent models more stably than AdamW, whose loss spiked to NaN at learning rate 5e-5; for the non-recurrent TinyLlama the gap is much smaller, with a small gain for Muon.
findings.zh: Muon 训练循环模型比 AdamW 稳定，AdamW（学习率 5e-5）的 loss 出现尖峰并变成 NaN；对非循环的 TinyLlama，两者差距小得多，Muon 略好。

tldr.en: Turn pretrained 1B models into prelude-core-coda recurrent models by dropping middle layers and looping a block, then keep training while a curriculum raises the mean recurrence.
tldr.zh: 从预训练 1B 模型中删掉中间几层、把一段层改为循环块，得到 prelude-core-coda 循环模型，再继续训练，并按课程逐步提高平均递归次数。

problem.en: Pretraining a depth-recurrent model from scratch is costly. Huginn-0125 used 800B tokens, and running many recurrences per step slows training compared with a fixed-depth model of the same parameter count. The paper studies how to convert existing pretrained non-recurrent models into recurrent ones efficiently.
problem.zh: 从头预训练深度循环模型代价高。Huginn-0125 用了 800B token，每步多次递归也让训练比同参数量的固定深度模型慢。本文研究如何高效地把现有的非循环预训练模型改造成循环模型。

en: Take a pretrained model's early layers as the prelude and later layers as the recurrent core and coda, dropping the layers in between, e.g. (4,8,4) from TinyLlama-1.1B-3T and (4,6,4) from OLMo-2-0425-1B and Llama-3.2-1B.

Keep Huginn-0125's recurrence, with a linear adapter on concat(prelude output, state), a random initial state, a Poisson-Lognormal recurrence count and gradients through at most the last 8 core passes.
Raise the mean of the recurrence distribution with a curriculum (1-sqrt over the first 75% of training in the main runs) to 4, 8, 16 or 32, and optimize with Muon.
Train on about 50B tokens of Nemotron-CC-Math-v1-4plus. To keep general ability, first heal on 26B tokens of FineWeb-Edu, then train on 26B tokens mixing FineWeb-Edu with Nemotron SFT data.
zh: 用预训练模型的前几层做 prelude，后几层做循环核心块和 coda，删掉中间的层，例如从 TinyLlama-1.1B-3T 取 (4,8,4)，从 OLMo-2-0425-1B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 取 (4,6,4)。
沿用 Huginn-0125 的循环方式，对 concat(prelude 输出, 状态) 做线性 adapter，初始状态随机，递归次数从 Poisson-Lognormal 分布采样，梯度最多只过最后 8 遍核心块。
用课程把递归分布的均值升到 4、8、16 或 32（主实验在前 75% 的训练里用 1-sqrt 课程），优化器用 Muon。
在约 50B token 的 Nemotron-CC-Math-v1-4plus 上训练。为保住通用能力，先用 26B token 的 FineWeb-Edu 做 healing，再用 26B token 的 FineWeb-Edu 与 Nemotron SFT 混合数据训练。

en: Models have about 1B parameters and are post-trained on about 50B tokens (about 120B in the initialization study); the authors say larger model and data scales still need testing.
All models are trained with a 1024-token context.

Against the non-recurrent parent, data and tokens are matched but parameters and compute are not. The recurrent models keep 72.7% (TinyLlama) or 87.5% (OLMo, Llama) of the parent's parameters and use more FLOPs per training step.
All models share one hyperparameter set (Muon with learning rate 0.001 and weight decay 1e-4, Appendix D); the baselines are not tuned separately.

Training only on math slightly lowers HellaSwag, Arc and OpenBookQA (Section 4.4). GSM8K and MATH use one in-context example, flexible extract for GSM8K and Minerva criteria with Math-Verify for MATH.
zh: 模型约 1B 参数，后训练约 50B token（初始化对比实验约 120B token）；作者表示更大的模型和数据规模还有待验证。
所有模型都用 1024 token 的上下文训练。
与非循环父模型相比，对齐了数据和 token，没对齐参数和算力。循环模型只保留父模型 72.7%（TinyLlama）或 87.5%（OLMo、Llama）的参数，每个训练 step 的 FLOPs 更多。
所有模型共用一套超参（Muon，学习率 0.001，weight decay 1e-4，Appendix D），基线没有单独调。
只用数学数据训练会让 HellaSwag、Arc、OpenBookQA 略降（Section 4.4）。GSM8K 和 MATH 用 1 个上下文示例评测，GSM8K 取 flexible extract，MATH 用 Minerva 标准加 Math-Verify。

papers.glyph: L0-3 (4 layers) -> [L10-17 (8 layers)] x Poisson-Lognormal, mean ramped to 4, 8, 16 or 32 -> L18-21 (4 layers); injection concat; KV n/a

papers.title: Loop as a Bridge: Can Looped Transformers Truly Link Representation Space and Natural Language Outputs?

tldr.en: Tests whether looping lets Ouro close the gap between internal representations and verbal outputs; more loops narrow it partly because representational knowledge degrades, and injected concepts are perceived only in the final loop.
tldr.zh: 检验循环能否让 Ouro 弥合内部表示与语言输出之间的差距；循环次数增加会缩小差距，但部分原因是表示中承载的知识在退化，且模型只在最后一遍循环中才能感知注入的概念。

papers.title: Depth-Recurrent Attention Mixture (Dreamer): Giving Latent Reasoning the Attention it Deserves

tldr.en: Dreamer combines sequence attention, depth attention and sparse expert attention in a depth-recurrent model; against FLOP-, parameter- and memory-matched baselines it needs 2 to 8x fewer training tokens for the same accuracy on language reasoning.
tldr.zh: Dreamer 在深度循环模型中结合序列注意力、沿深度的注意力和稀疏专家注意力；与 FLOP、参数和显存都匹配的基线相比，在语言推理基准上达到相同准确率所需的训练 token 少 2 到 8 倍。

papers.title: LoopViT: Scaling Visual ARC with Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Loop-ViT iterates a weight-tied hybrid convolution-attention block on ARC-AGI grids and at inference halts once predictive entropy is low; the 18M model reaches 65.8% on ARC-AGI-1, above 73M-parameter ensembles.
tldr.zh: Loop-ViT 在 ARC-AGI 网格上反复迭代一个权重共享的卷积加注意力混合块，推理时在预测熵足够低时停止；18M 模型在 ARC-AGI-1 上达到 65.8%，超过 73M 参数的集成模型。

papers.title: Recurrent-Depth VLA: Implicit Test-Time Compute Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models via Latent Iterative Reasoning

tldr.en: RD-VLA gives a VLA a weight-tied recurrent action head that stops on latent convergence; tasks failing at one iteration exceed 90 percent success with four, and inference is up to 80x faster than reasoning VLAs.
tldr.zh: RD-VLA 为 VLA 加入权重共享的循环动作头，并按隐状态收敛自适应停止；单次迭代完全失败的任务在四次迭代时成功率超过 90%，推理速度比以往基于推理的 VLA 最多快 80x。

papers.title: Looping Back to Move Forward: Recursive Transformers for Efficient and Flexible Large Multimodal Models

tldr.en: RecursiveVLM loops a multimodal model's LLM backbone, adding a Recursive Connector that fuses intermediate-layer states per modality and a Monotonic Recursion Loss; it gains +3% over standard Transformers and +7% over vanilla recursive baselines.
tldr.zh: RecursiveVLM 循环多模态模型的 LLM 主干，加入按模态融合中间层状态的 Recursive Connector 和 Monotonic Recursion Loss；相比标准 Transformer 提升 +3%，相比普通递归基线提升 +7%。

papers.title: Prioritize the Process, Not Just the Outcome: Rewarding Latent Thought Trajectories Improves Reasoning in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: RLTT replaces GRPO's final-state credit with reward spread over the whole latent thought trajectory of looped LMs; on Ouro-Thinking it raises mean math accuracy over GRPO by +5.8% at 1.4B and +10.9% at 2.6B.
tldr.zh: RLTT 不再像 GRPO 那样只给最终隐状态分配信用，而是把奖励分配到循环语言模型的整条隐式思考轨迹上；在 Ouro-Thinking 上，数学基准平均准确率比 GRPO 在 1.4B 规模提高 +5.8%，在 2.6B 规模提高 +10.9%。

papers.title: LoopFormer: Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers for Latent Reasoning via Shortcut Modulation

tldr.en: Trains one looped Transformer for many depths via time and step-size conditioning and a shortcut-consistency loss; it performs well on language modeling and reasoning under tight compute budgets and improves as the budget grows.
tldr.zh: 通过时间与步长条件化和 shortcut-consistency 损失，让同一个循环 Transformer 适配多种深度；它在较紧的计算预算下仍能在语言建模和推理上表现良好，并随预算增加而提升。

papers.title: SpiralFormer: Looped Transformers Can Learn Hierarchical Dependencies via Multi-Resolution Recursion

tldr.en: SpiralFormer runs a looped Transformer's shared core at a different sequence resolution each iteration, coarse to fine; from 160M to 1.4B it beats looped and non-looped baselines in parameter and compute efficiency.
tldr.zh: SpiralFormer 让循环 Transformer 的共享核心在每次迭代中以不同的序列分辨率运行（由粗到细）；在 160M 到 1.4B 规模上，其参数效率和计算效率都优于循环与非循环基线。

papers.title: From Growing to Looping: A Unified View of Iterative Computation in LLMs

tldr.en: Looped and depth-grown (middle-layer duplication) LLMs share depth-wise signatures of iterative computation; looping a middle block of a depth-grown model at inference, without loop training, raises accuracy on some reasoning primitives by up to 2x.
tldr.zh: 循环模型与深度生长（复制中间层）得到的 LLM 具有共同的逐层迭代计算特征；在推理时对未经循环训练的深度生长模型循环其中间块，可使部分推理基元的准确率最多提升到 2 倍。

papers.title: AdaPonderLM: Gated Pondering Language Models with Token-Wise Adaptive Depth

tldr.en: AdaPonderLM, a recurrent LM, learns token-wise halting with iteration-specific MLP gates and reuses KV states of halted tokens; it cuts inference compute by about 10% at comparable perplexity, spending more compute on high-NLL tokens.
tldr.zh: AdaPonderLM 是一种循环语言模型，用每次迭代专属的 MLP 门控学习按 token 停止，并复用已停止 token 的 KV；在困惑度相当的情况下推理计算量减少约 10%，并把更多计算分配给高 NLL 的 token。

papers.title: Mixture of Universal Experts: Scaling Virtual Width via Depth-Width Transformation

tldr.en: MoUE reuses a shared pool of universal experts across MoE layers under a fixed activation budget; it beats matched MoE baselines by up to 1.3% and converts existing MoE checkpoints with up to 4.2% gains.
tldr.zh: MoUE 在固定的激活预算下让多个 MoE 层复用同一个通用专家池；它比匹配的 MoE 基线最多高 1.3%，并能把已有 MoE checkpoint 转换过来，最多带来 4.2% 的提升。

papers.title: Adaptive Loops and Memory in Transformers: Think Harder or Know More?

tldr.en: Lets each block loop with learned halting and adds gated memory banks; looping mainly helps math, memory banks help commonsense tasks, and combined they beat an iso-FLOP baseline with three times the layers on math.
tldr.zh: 让每个 Transformer 块借助学习的停止机制自适应循环，并加入门控记忆库；循环主要提升数学推理，记忆库有助于常识任务，两者结合后在数学基准上超过层数为其三倍的等 FLOP 基线。

papers.title: Universal YOCO for Efficient Depth Scaling

note.en: Section 4.1 model, a 20-layer YOCO with MoE FFNs (1.3B activated, 10B total). The 10-layer self-decoder uses SWA with window 512 and RoPE and is applied T=3 times with shared weights; its final output is projected once into the global KV that all 10 cross-decoder layers (NoPE) read. Each iteration keeps its own window cache. Figure 6 trains separate 1.3B models with 1, 2, 3 and 5 loops.
note.zh: Section 4.1 的模型是 20 层 YOCO，FFN 为 MoE（1.3B 激活，10B 总参数）。10 层 self-decoder 用窗口 512 的 SWA 和 RoPE，共享权重连续跑 T=3 次；最后一次的输出只投影一次，得到 10 层 cross-decoder（NoPE）共用的全局 KV。每次迭代各存自己的窗口缓存。Figure 6 另外训练了 1、2、3、5 遍的 1.3B 模型。

baseline.en: Non-recursive YOCO with the same configuration and hyperparameters (Loop=1); Section 4.2 adds a Transformer, a Universal Transformer looped twice, RINS and ParScale at 1.3B dense.
baseline.zh: 配置和超参都相同、不循环的 YOCO（Loop=1）；Section 4.2 另有 1.3B dense 的 Transformer、整模型循环两遍的 Universal Transformer、RINS 和 ParScale。

headline.en: With the same 1.3B-activated / 10B-total MoE, YOCO-U at equal training FLOPs averages 46.23 on the Table 2 tasks against 41.78 for non-recursive YOCO (+4.45), and 47.08 at equal steps; at equal FLOPs its loss is lower by 0.033.
headline.zh: 同样 1.3B 激活 / 10B 总参数的 MoE，等训练 FLOPs 时 YOCO-U 在 Table 2 任务上平均 46.23，不循环的 YOCO 为 41.78（+4.45）；等步数时为 47.08；等 FLOPs 时 loss 低 0.033。

results.setting: Section 4.1 MoE (1.3B activated, 10B total), 20 layers, 8192 training length, trained up to 300B tokens, T=3

note.en: The paper does not state how many training tokens the Equal FLOPS row used.
note.zh: 论文没写 Equal FLOPS 那一行训练了多少 token。

results.setting: Thinking SFT from the 280B checkpoint, 20B tokens of math thinking data, 32768 maximal length; greedy decoding up to 32,768 tokens
1.3B dense, 20 layers, hidden 2560, 20B tokens; the compute-scaling variants are aligned to approximately 2× the FLOPs of a standard 20-layer Transformer
1.3B dense ablations; the YOCO and YOCO-U rows repeat the Table 3 values at two decimals

note.en: Deep and Deeper double the depth at the same model size (Deeper has hidden size 1792 and 40 layers). Upper Loop loops the cross-decoder instead of the self-decoder; the w/o Shared KV variant uses self-attention there.
note.zh: Deep 和 Deeper 在模型大小不变时把深度加倍（Deeper 的 hidden 为 1792、40 层）。Upper Loop 改为循环 cross-decoder；w/o Shared KV 变体在那里改用 self-attention。

results.setting: 1.3B configuration of Section 4.4, Nano-vLLM in BF16 on H100-80GB, generation batch size 32, length 128
results.metric: at 256K length, prefill tokens/s / decode tokens/s / KV cache MB

note.en: Section 4.5 states that YOCO-U gives up 5% of YOCO's decoding throughput, decodes 2.21× faster than the Transformer at 256K, and that RINS needs 38× the KV memory of YOCO-U.
note.zh: Section 4.5 称 YOCO-U 的解码吞吐比 YOCO 低 5%，256K 时解码速度是 Transformer 的 2.21 倍；RINS 的 KV 显存是 YOCO-U 的 38 倍。

findings.en: Looping the cross-decoder instead of the self-decoder averages 47.34 (46.41 without the shared KV), against 48.25 for YOCO-U and 46.95 for non-recursive YOCO; the authors conclude that recursion on deeper layers gives diminishing improvement regardless of the KV cache strategy.
findings.zh: 改为循环 cross-decoder 平均 47.34（不共享 KV 时 46.41），YOCO-U 为 48.25，不循环的 YOCO 为 46.95；作者据此认为在更深的层上循环收益递减，与 KV 策略无关。

findings.en: At about 2× FLOPs, looping the whole 20-layer Transformer twice averages 47.8, while RINS and YOCO-U both reach 48.3; the authors read this as scaling FLOPs on bottom blocks being more effective than on all blocks.
findings.zh: 约 2 倍 FLOPs 下，整个 20 层 Transformer 循环两遍平均 47.8，RINS 和 YOCO-U 都是 48.3；作者认为把 FLOPs 加在底部的块上比加在所有块上更有效。

findings.en: Separately trained 1.3B models with 1, 2, 3 and 5 loops show consistent improvements in validation loss as the loop count grows; Loop=5 uses 3 times the FLOPs of the non-recursive model. The figure prints no per-loop values.
findings.zh: 分别训练 1、2、3、5 遍的 1.3B 模型，验证 loss 随遍数增加持续改善；Loop=5 的 FLOPs 是不循环模型的 3 倍。图中没有印出各遍数的数值。

findings.en: YOCO-U trained on 80B tokens is comparable with non-recursive YOCO trained on 210B tokens (approximately 62% fewer tokens).
findings.zh: YOCO-U 训练 80B token 的效果与不循环的 YOCO 训练 210B token 相当（约少用 62% 的 token）。

findings.en: With training steps fixed, YOCO-U matches YOCO with 50% fewer parameters; when activated parameters are aligned, the authors say YOCO-U narrows the gap to non-recursive models and is near-comparable above 10B.
findings.zh: 训练步数相同时，YOCO-U 用少 50% 的参数达到 YOCO 的效果；按激活参数对齐时，作者称 YOCO-U 与不循环模型的差距缩小，超过 10B 时接近持平。

findings.en: On Needle-in-a-Haystack, YOCO-U scores 1.00 (S-NIAH-1) and 0.95 (S-NIAH-2), against 0.87 and 0.82 for the Transformer and 0.99 and 0.91 for RINS.
findings.zh: Needle-in-a-Haystack 上 YOCO-U 得分 1.00（S-NIAH-1）和 0.95（S-NIAH-2），Transformer 为 0.87 和 0.82，RINS 为 0.99 和 0.91。

tldr.en: Loop only YOCO's self-decoder, whose layers use sliding-window attention, so extra depth costs compute while the cross-decoder's global KV is still computed once.
tldr.zh: 只循环 YOCO 的 self-decoder（这些层用 SWA），加深只多花计算，cross-decoder 用的全局 KV 仍只算一次。

problem.en: Looping a standard Transformer re-runs every layer, which regenerates KV caches and repeats global attention, so memory and compute grow with depth.
problem.zh: 循环标准 Transformer 要重跑所有层，每遍重新生成 KV、重复全局注意力，显存和计算都随深度增长。

en: Start from YOCO, where an L/2-layer self-decoder with efficient self-attention (SWA by default) produces one global KV cache that every layer of the L/2-layer cross-decoder reads through cross-attention.
Replace the self-decoder with a Universal Self-Decoder that applies the same L/2 layers T times in sequence (T=3 by default, 2× the total FLOPs of the non-recursive baseline).
Project the global KV from the final iteration's output, so its size does not depend on T; only the SWA window caches grow with T.
zh: 以 YOCO 为基础：L/2 层的 self-decoder 用高效注意力（默认 SWA），产出一份全局 KV，L/2 层的 cross-decoder 每层都通过 cross-attention 读它。
把 self-decoder 换成 Universal Self-Decoder，同一组 L/2 层依次跑 T 次（默认 T=3，总 FLOPs 是不循环基线的 2 倍）。
全局 KV 由最后一次迭代的输出投影得到，大小与 T 无关；只有 SWA 的窗口缓存随 T 增长。

en: The headline runs are a 1.3B-activated / 10B-total MoE trained on up to 300B tokens; the architecture comparison, ablations and loop scaling use 1.3B dense models trained on 20B tokens, and the efficiency tests use the same 1.3B configuration. Training length is 8192 in Sections 4.1 and 4.4.
Each model is trained and tested with one fixed loop count (3 by default; 1, 2, 3 and 5 in Figure 6); the paper does not report changing the loop count at inference.
Training FLOPs are computed as tokens × layers (Section 4.1), and the Equal FLOPS row of Table 2 does not state its token count.
The KV cache is not identical to YOCO's because each self-decoder iteration keeps its own window cache (Table 10, 46 MB vs 26 MB at 8K and 542 vs 522 MB at 256K).
Prefill throughput is below non-recursive YOCO's, 76301 vs 220407 tokens/s at 256K (Table 8).
Table 5 does not state the loop count or FLOPs of the Upper Loop variants.
zh: 主结果是 1.3B 激活 / 10B 总参数的 MoE，最多训练 300B token；架构对比、消融和遍数扩展用 1.3B dense 模型，训练 20B token，效率测试也用这个 1.3B 配置。Section 4.1 和 4.4 的训练长度是 8192。
每个模型训练和测试都用同一个固定遍数（默认 3，Figure 6 中有 1、2、3、5）；论文没有报告推理时改变遍数。
训练 FLOPs 按 token × 层数计算（Section 4.1），Table 2 的 Equal FLOPS 行没写训练了多少 token。
KV 和 YOCO 并不完全相同，因为 self-decoder 每次迭代各存自己的窗口缓存（Table 10，8K 时 46 MB 对 26 MB，256K 时 542 MB 对 522 MB）。
prefill 吞吐低于不循环的 YOCO，256K 时为 76301 对 220407 tokens/s（Table 8）。
Table 5 没写 Upper Loop 变体的遍数和 FLOPs。

papers.title: Loop, Think, & Generalize: Implicit Reasoning in Recurrent-Depth Transformers

tldr.en: Trains recurrent-depth Transformers from scratch on implicit multi-hop knowledge composition; unlike vanilla Transformers they generalize systematically through a three-stage grokking process and extrapolate to deeper compositions with more inference-time iterations, until overthinking degrades predictions.
tldr.zh: 在隐式多跳知识组合任务上从头训练循环深度 Transformer；与普通 Transformer 不同，它们经过三阶段 grokking 实现系统性泛化，并能随推理时迭代次数增加外推到更深的组合，但过度迭代（overthinking）会使预测变差。

papers.title: ELT: Elastic Looped Transformers for Visual Generation

tldr.en: ELT loops weight-shared transformer blocks for image and video generation and distills the maximum-loop output into intermediate loops for any-time inference; with 4× fewer parameters at iso-inference compute, it reaches FID 2.0 on ImageNet 256×256.
tldr.zh: ELT 用权重共享的循环 Transformer 块做图像和视频生成，并把最大循环次数的输出蒸馏给中间各遍以支持随时退出的推理；在推理算力相同、参数少 4× 的设置下，它在 ImageNet 256×256 上达到 FID 2.0。

papers.title: A Mechanistic Analysis of Looped Reasoning Language Models

tldr.en: Analyzes latent states of pretrained looped language models; in many, each recurrent-block layer converges to a distinct fixed point and each iteration repeats feedforward-like stages of inference, depending on input injection and normalization.
tldr.zh: 分析预训练循环语言模型的隐状态；在许多被研究的模型中，循环块的每一层都收敛到各自不同的不动点，每次迭代都重复与前馈模型相似的推理阶段，这些现象受输入注入和归一化方式影响。

papers.title: Parcae: Scaling Laws For Stable Looped Language Models

note.en: Shown for the 1.3B model of the Transformer comparison (Table 18), which has 8 prelude, 8 recurrent and 8 coda blocks against a 24-layer Transformer; the 140M, 370M and 770M models use 2, 4 and 6 blocks per unit, and all loop the middle third. Each step computes h_{t+1} = Ā h_t + B̄ e + R̄(h_t, e) with Ā = exp(ΔA) for a negative diagonal A (ZOH), B̄ = ΔB (Euler) and a normalized prelude output e. The Section 5.1 models are also evaluated at T = 1-16 and the Section 5.3 models up to T = 24.
note.zh: 图示为 Transformer 对比中的 1.3B 模型（Table 18）：prelude、循环块、coda 各 8 层，对照是 24 层 Transformer；140M、370M、770M 每段分别为 2、4、6 层，循环的都是中间三分之一。每一步计算 h_{t+1} = Ā h_t + B̄ e + R̄(h_t, e)，其中 Ā = exp(ΔA)，A 为负对角矩阵（ZOH 离散化），B̄ = ΔB（Euler），e 是归一化后的 prelude 输出。Section 5.1 的模型还在 T = 1-16 上评测，Section 5.3 的模型评测到 T = 24。

baseline.en: Fixed-depth Transformers in a simplified nanochat setup with the same parameter count and training data; Huginn-style RDMs with matched parameters and data are a second baseline.
baseline.zh: 简化 nanochat 设置下参数量和训练数据相同的定深 Transformer；另一组对照是参数和数据都对齐的 Huginn 式 RDM。

headline.en: At 1.3B parameters and the same data, Parcae (T=8) scores 28.44 Core and 17.08 Core-Extended against the Transformer's 25.45 and 15.90 (+2.99 and +1.18 points); the 770M Parcae's 25.07 Core is comparable to the 1.3B Transformer with roughly half the parameters.
headline.zh: 1.3B 参数、相同数据下，Parcae（T=8）的 Core / Core-Extended 为 28.44 / 17.08，Transformer 为 25.45 / 15.90（高 2.99 和 1.18 分）；770M 的 Parcae Core 为 25.07，用约一半参数与 1.3B Transformer 相当。

results.setting: Transformer setup (simplified nanochat), FineWeb-Edu, 2,048 context, parameter- and data-matched pairs trained on 11.2B, 29.6B, 61.6B and 104B tokens at 140M, 370M, 770M and 1.3B; Parcae evaluated at T=8
RDM setup of Geiping et al. (Huginn data and tokenizer); 100M evaluated at T=16, 350M at T=8
results.metric: validation PPL / WikiText PPL / zero-shot average of six tasks

results.setting: Transformer setup at 140M and 370M with parameters and training FLOPs fixed (tokens shrink as μ_rec grows); fixed depth means μ_rec = 1
results.metric: optimal μ_rec* / Core at μ_rec* / Core at fixed depth

results.setting: RDM-setup Parcae models (100M trained with μ_rec 16, 350M with μ_rec 8), depth sampled per micro-batch or per sequence

findings.en: Run at up to twice the training mean (μ_rec = 8), the 140M-1.3B models' gains plateau near T = μ_rec; the authors read this as training depth setting the test-time ceiling.
findings.zh: 140M–1.3B 模型推理时跑到训练均值 μ_rec = 8 的两倍，收益在 T = μ_rec 附近就饱和；作者认为训练深度决定了推理时 scaling 的上限。

findings.en: Loss against test-time T follows L(T) = L∞ + Z·exp(−zT); fitted on T ≤ μ_rec and tested on T > μ_rec, this form has the lowest error of the four forms tried (Huber loss 3.18 and 2.29 x10^-7 at 140M and 370M).
findings.zh: loss 随推理遍数 T 的变化符合 L(T) = L∞ + Z·exp(−zT)；用 T ≤ μ_rec 拟合、在 T > μ_rec 上检验时，它在四种候选形式中误差最低（140M 和 370M 的 Huber loss 为 3.18 和 2.29 x10^-7）。

findings.en: Sampling the total depth from Λ(μ_rec) and then truncating backprop, instead of sampling only the no-gradient steps as Geiping et al. do, keeps validation loss at T = 4, 16 and 64 closer to full backprop (100M models, 10B tokens, μ_rec = μ_bwd = 8).
findings.zh: 先从 Λ(μ_rec) 采样总遍数再截断反传，而不是像 Geiping et al. 那样只采样不带梯度的步数，能让 T = 4、16、64 时的验证 loss 更接近全程反传（100M 模型，10B token，μ_rec = μ_bwd = 8）。

findings.en: With parameters and FLOPs fixed, the optimal μ_rec grows with the budget (2 at 1x10^18 to 10 at 64x10^18 FLOPs for 140M) and follows a power law with exponent about 0.40; the optimal token count follows one with exponent about 0.78.
findings.zh: 固定参数和 FLOPs 时，最优 μ_rec 随预算增大（140M 从 1x10^18 FLOPs 时的 2 增到 64x10^18 时的 10），服从指数约 0.40 的幂律；最优 token 数服从指数约 0.78 的幂律。

findings.en: In early RDM runs made before the Appendix H sampling fix (10B tokens, μ_bwd = 4, evaluated at T = μ_rec), μ_rec = 8 gave the lowest validation loss (2.453) among values from 4 to 32; in a second sweep at μ_rec = 20 (8.5B tokens), raising μ_bwd from 4 to 12 lowered it from 2.500 to 2.474.
findings.zh: 在 Appendix H 采样修正之前的早期 RDM 实验里（10B token，μ_bwd = 4，按 T = μ_rec 评测），μ_rec 取 4 到 32 时 μ_rec = 8 的验证 loss 最低（2.453）；另一组 μ_rec = 20 的实验（8.5B token）中，把 μ_bwd 从 4 提到 12，loss 从 2.500 降到 2.474。

findings.en: Across learning rates from 2e-4 to 1e-3, the Pre-Norm RDM converges only at 2e-4 and the residual-norm RDM up to 4e-4, while Parcae converges at all five.
findings.zh: 学习率从 2e-4 到 1e-3 的五档中，Pre-Norm RDM 只在 2e-4 收敛，残差归一化 RDM 只到 4e-4，Parcae 五档全部收敛。

tldr.en: Constrain the loop's injection to a stable negative-diagonal form, sample depth per sequence, and fit training and test-time scaling laws for looping at fixed parameter count.
tldr.zh: 把循环的注入约束成稳定的负对角形式，按序列采样遍数训练，并在固定参数量下拟合循环的训练和推理 scaling law。

problem.en: Middle-looped models such as Huginn-style RDMs diverge or show loss spikes unless hyperparameters are chosen carefully; the paper traces this to injection parameters whose linearized state matrix reaches a spectral radius of 1 or more, and asks whether a stable looped model scales predictably with loops.
problem.zh: Huginn 式 RDM 等中段循环模型若超参没选好就会发散或出现 loss spike；论文把原因归到注入参数线性化后的状态矩阵谱半径达到或超过 1，并研究稳定后的循环模型能否随循环遍数可预测地 scale。

en: Write each loop step as h_{t+1} = Ā h_t + B̄ e + R̄(h_t, e) and parameterize A as a negative diagonal discretized with ZOH, so the spectral radius of Ā stays below 1; the prelude output e is normalized before injection.
Sample the depth T per sequence from a Poisson distribution with mean μ_rec, backpropagate through the last μ_bwd = ⌈μ_rec/2⌉ steps, and loop the middle third of a nanochat-style Transformer.
Fit isoFLOP scaling laws over μ_rec and tokens at fixed parameters (140M, 370M) and a saturating exponential law for loss against test-time T, then join them in one unified law.
zh: 把每一步循环写成 h_{t+1} = Ā h_t + B̄ e + R̄(h_t, e)，A 参数化为负对角矩阵并用 ZOH 离散化，使 Ā 的谱半径始终小于 1；prelude 输出 e 注入前先归一化。
每条序列的遍数 T 从均值为 μ_rec 的 Poisson 分布采样，只反传最后 μ_bwd = ⌈μ_rec/2⌉ 步；循环 nanochat 式 Transformer 中间三分之一的层。
在固定参数（140M、370M）下拟合 μ_rec 与 token 数的 isoFLOP scaling law，再拟合 loss 随推理遍数 T 变化的饱和指数律，最后合成一个统一的 scaling law。

en: Experiments stop at 1.3B parameters, 104B tokens and a 2,048-token context with dense FFNs; the scaling laws are fitted only at 140M and 370M, and the authors say their observations are limited to small architectures (Section 6).

Parameters and data are matched (Parcae has 0.35-0.83% more parameters, Table 19) but compute is not; at T = 8 the recurrent block runs 8 times per token, and the paper reports neither KV-cache size nor inference cost.
The Transformer and RDM baselines got their own learning-rate sweeps, and Parcae reused the baselines' best settings without a sweep of its own (Section 5.1; Appendix Q).
Test-time gains saturate near the training mean μ_rec, and the authors note that a larger μ_rec needs more test-time steps for equivalent quality (Section 5.3; Section 6).
zh: 实验最大到 1.3B 参数、104B token、2,048 上下文，FFN 为 dense；scaling law 只在 140M 和 370M 上拟合，作者也说结论仅限于小模型（Section 6）。
对齐了参数（Parcae 多 0.35-0.83%，Table 19）和数据，没对齐算力：T = 8 时循环块每个 token 跑 8 遍；论文没有报告 KV 大小或推理成本。
Transformer 和 RDM 基线各自扫过学习率，Parcae 直接沿用基线的最优设置，没有单独扫（Section 5.1；Appendix Q）。
推理收益在训练均值 μ_rec 附近饱和；作者指出 μ_rec 越大，达到同等质量需要的推理步数越多（Section 5.3；Section 6）。
