papers.title: Stability and Generalization in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: A fixed-point analysis of looped transformers proves that models without recall cannot achieve strong input-dependence, while recall with outer normalization yields stable, input-dependent fixed points; small models on chess, sudoku and prefix-sums follow these predictions.
tldr.zh: 对循环 Transformer 的不动点分析证明，没有 recall 的模型无法获得强输入依赖，而 recall 加外层归一化能得到稳定且依赖输入的不动点；在国际象棋、数独和前缀和任务上训练的小模型符合这些预测。

papers.title: How Much Is One Recurrence Worth? Iso-Depth Scaling Laws for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Fits a joint scaling law over an iso-depth pretraining sweep of looped language models and measures a recurrence-equivalence exponent of 0.46, so replacing unique blocks with shared recurrences raises validation loss at matched training compute.
tldr.zh: 在循环语言模型的等深度预训练扫描上拟合联合 scaling law，测得 recurrence-equivalence 指数为 0.46，说明在训练算力匹配时用共享的循环替换独立块会提高验证损失。

papers.title: Hyperloop Transformers

tldr.en: Hyperloop Transformers loop the middle block and add loop-level hyper-connections with matrix-valued residual streams; across scales they compare well with depth-matched Transformer and mHC baselines while using approximately 50% fewer parameters.
tldr.zh: Hyperloop Transformer 只循环中段模块，并在每次循环后用 hyper-connections 写入矩阵形式的多路残差流；在多个规模上，它用约 50% 更少的参数，与深度匹配的 Transformer 和 mHC 基线相比表现良好。

papers.title: Universal Transformers Need Memory: Depth-State Trade-offs in Adaptive Recursive Reasoning

tldr.en: Studies learned memory tokens in a single-block Universal Transformer with ACT on Sudoku-Extreme; without them no configuration reaches non-trivial accuracy, and inverting the halting-router bias to -3 avoids an initialization trap that breaks most runs.
tldr.zh: 研究单块 Universal Transformer 加 ACT 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上使用可学习 memory token 的效果；没有 memory token 时任何配置都达不到有意义的准确率，把停止路由器的偏置反转为 -3 可避开导致多数训练失败的初始化陷阱。

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Looped Transformer: Decoupling Compute from Memory in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: MELT, fine-tuned from Ouro, keeps one KV cache per layer that is shared across loops and updated by a learned gate; it outperforms comparable-size LLMs with a similar memory footprint, far smaller than Ouro's.
tldr.zh: MELT 从 Ouro 微调而来，每层只保留一份跨循环共享、由可学习门控更新的 KV cache；它优于参数规模相当的标准 LLM，显存占用与之相近，远小于 Ouro。

papers.title: Sparse Layers are Critical to Scaling Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Compares dense and MoE transformers with and without looping; Looped-MoE out-scales the standard baseline while dense looped models do not, since routing picks different experts per pass, and loop boundaries are better early-exit points.
tldr.zh: 比较带循环和不带循环的 dense 与 MoE Transformer；Looped-MoE 的 scaling 优于标准基线而 dense 循环模型不然，原因是路由在每一遍激活不同的专家；循环边界也是更好的 early exit 点。

papers.title: LoopUS: Recasting Pretrained LLMs into Looped Latent Refinement Models

tldr.en: LoopUS splits a pretrained LLM into encoder, looped reasoning block and decoder, adding a selective gate, random deep supervision and a confidence head for early exit; this improves reasoning-oriented performance without recurrent training from scratch.
tldr.zh: LoopUS 把预训练 LLM 拆成 encoder、循环的推理块和 decoder，并加入选择性门控、随机深度监督和用于提前退出的置信度头；无需从头训练循环模型即可提升偏推理任务的表现。

papers.title: Solve the Loop: Attractor Models for Language and Reasoning

tldr.en: Attractor Models refine a backbone's output embedding by solving for a fixed point with implicit gradients, keeping training memory constant; a 770M model outperforms a 1.3B Transformer trained on twice as many tokens.
tldr.zh: Attractor Models 先由 backbone 给出输出嵌入，再由 attractor 模块求解不动点进行精炼，并用隐式微分求梯度，训练显存不随有效深度增长；770M 的 Attractor Model 超过用两倍 token 训练的 1.3B Transformer。

papers.title: Simply Stabilizing the Loop via Fully Looped Transformer

tldr.en: Fully Looped Transformer injects the previous loop's output into every layer by reusing self-attention, adding no parameters; it curbs residual explosion and gradient oscillation and trains stably up to 12 loop iterations, where baselines collapse.
tldr.zh: Fully Looped Transformer 通过复用 self-attention 把上一遍循环的输出注入每一层，不增加参数；它抑制残差爆炸和梯度振荡，可稳定训练到 12 次循环，而基线循环模型在这一设置下会崩溃。

papers.title: Generative Recursive Reasoning

tldr.en: GRAM makes recursive reasoning models stochastic latent-variable generative models trained by amortized variational inference, scaling inference by recursion depth and parallel trajectory sampling; it beats deterministic recursive baselines on structured and multi-solution reasoning.
tldr.zh: GRAM 把递归推理模型变成带随机潜在轨迹的隐变量生成模型，用摊销变分推断训练，推理时可按递归深度和并行采样的轨迹数扩展；在结构化推理和多解约束满足任务上优于确定性的循环和递归基线。

papers.title: Probabilistic Tiny Recursive Model

tldr.en: PTRM injects Gaussian noise at each deep recursion step of a trained TRM to run parallel trajectories and selects among them with its Q head; without retraining, Sudoku-Extreme accuracy rises from 87.4% to 98.75%.
tldr.zh: PTRM 在训练好的 TRM 每个深度递归步注入高斯噪声以并行运行多条轨迹，并用模型自带的 Q head 选出答案；无需重新训练，Sudoku-Extreme 准确率从 87.4% 提高到 98.75%。

papers.title: HRM-Text: Efficient Pretraining Beyond Scaling

tldr.en: HRM-Text pretrains a hierarchical recurrent language model with MagicNorm, warmup deep credit assignment and a task-completion objective on instruction-response pairs; a 1B model on 40 billion unique tokens performs competitively with 2-7B open models.
tldr.zh: HRM-Text 用 MagicNorm、warmup deep credit assignment 和基于指令-回复对的任务完成目标预训练分层循环语言模型；在 40 billion 个不重复 token 上训练的 1B 模型与 2-7B 参数的开源模型表现相当。

papers.title: LT2: Linear-Time Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LT2 replaces softmax attention in looped transformers with linear or sparse attention; looping refines linear-attention memory and widens the sparse receptive field, and hybrid variants match or surpass the standard looped transformer at lower cost.
tldr.zh: LT2 把循环 Transformer 中的 softmax 注意力换成线性或稀疏注意力；循环会迭代细化线性注意力的记忆并扩大稀疏注意力的有效感受野，混合变体以更低成本达到或超过标准循环 Transformer。

papers.title: Equilibrium Reasoners: Learning Attractors Enables Scalable Reasoning

tldr.en: Equilibrium Reasoners frame iterative latent reasoning as learning task-conditioned attractors and scale depth and breadth at test time; gains track convergence to solution attractors, reaching over 99% on Sudoku-Extreme versus 2.6% for feedforward models.
tldr.zh: Equilibrium Reasoners 把迭代式隐空间推理视为学习任务条件下的吸引子，并在测试时沿深度和广度扩展计算；收益与向解吸引子的收敛程度紧密相关，在 Sudoku-Extreme 上准确率超过 99%，而前馈模型只有 2.6%。

papers.title: Training-Free Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Loops a contiguous mid-stack block of a frozen checkpoint at inference without training; naive reapplication usually hurts, but damped sub-steps of the block's ODE update help, e.g. +2.64 pp MMLU-Pro on Qwen3-4B-Instruct.
tldr.zh: 在推理时不经训练地循环冻结 checkpoint 中一段连续的中间层块；朴素重复通常会降低性能，而把循环看作该块 ODE 更新的阻尼子步则能带来提升，例如 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 在 MMLU-Pro 上提高 +2.64 pp。

papers.title: Stabilizing Recurrent Dynamics for Test-Time Scalable Latent Reasoning in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: STARS trains looped LMs with Jacobian spectral radius regularization and random loop sampling so latent states approach stable fixed points, giving reliable test-time scaling on arithmetic and less degradation with deeper recurrence in math reasoning.
tldr.zh: STARS 用 Jacobian 谱半径正则和随机循环次数采样训练循环语言模型，使隐状态趋向稳定不动点；在算术任务上实现可靠的 test-time scaling，在数学推理中循环加深时性能下降更少。

papers.title: Latent Recurrent Transformer: Architecture Exploration, Training Strategies, and Scaling Behavior

tldr.en: LRT feeds the previous token's high-level hidden state into the next token's layers; at matched effective compute it improves BPB and CORE and matches a three-loop Transformer in BPB, with one forward per token.
tldr.zh: LRT 把前一个 token 的高层隐藏状态送入下一个 token 的各层；在等效算力相同时提升 BPB 和 CORE，BPB 与三遍循环 Transformer 持平，且每个 token 仍只需一次前向。

papers.title: Déjà View: Looping Transformers for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction

tldr.en: DéjàView applies a single looped transformer block to per-view features for K refinement steps in multi-view 3D reconstruction; it matches or beats much larger feed-forward models on five benchmarks and beats an untied per-step variant.
tldr.zh: DéjàView 在多视角 3D 重建中把同一个循环 transformer block 在每个视角的特征上应用 K 步精炼；在五个基准上达到或超过大得多的前馈模型，也优于每步参数独立的变体。

papers.title: LoopMoE: Unifying Iterative Computation with Mixture-of-Experts for Language Modeling

tldr.en: LoopMoE loops an MoE block with iteration- and token-conditioned normalization (IterAdaLN); over a vanilla MoE with identical parameters and FLOPs, its average gain grows from over 1 point at 3B to approximately 3 at 9B.
tldr.zh: LoopMoE 循环复用一个 MoE 块，并用同时以迭代序号和每个 token 隐状态为条件的归一化（IterAdaLN）区分各次迭代；与总参数和每 token FLOPs 相同的 vanilla MoE 相比，平均提升从 3B 规模的 1 分以上增至 9B 规模的约 3 分。

papers.title: Skip a Layer or Loop It? Learning Program-of-Layers in LLMs

tldr.en: Shows that frozen pretrained LLMs admit per-input programs that skip or repeat layer segments, and trains a lightweight predictor of such programs that improves math reasoning accuracy over standard inference, often using fewer layers.
tldr.zh: 发现冻结的预训练 LLM 对每个输入都存在跳过或重复层段的执行程序，并训练一个轻量预测网络生成这类程序，在数学推理上比标准推理更准确，且常常执行更少的层。

papers.title: LoopCoder-v2: Only Loop Once for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling

tldr.en: LoopCoder-v2 trains 7B Parallel Loop Transformer coders on 18T tokens; two loops lift SWE-bench Verified from 43.0 (non-looped) to 64.4, but three or more regress as later-loop gains shrink against a roughly fixed position-offset cost.
tldr.zh: LoopCoder-v2 在 18T token 上训练 7B 的 Parallel Loop Transformer 代码模型；两遍循环把 SWE-bench Verified 从不循环时的 43.0 提到 64.4，三遍及以上反而退步，因为后续循环的收益递减，而位置偏移代价大致不变。

papers.title: Fixed-Point Reasoners: Stable and Adaptive Deep Looped Transformers

tldr.en: FPRM stabilizes deep looped Transformers with pre-norm layers and residual scaling and halts when the hidden state reaches a fixed point, adapting compute to task difficulty; it is effective on Sudoku, Maze, state-tracking and ARC-AGI.
tldr.zh: FPRM 用 pre-norm 层和残差缩放稳定深层循环 Transformer，并在隐藏状态到达不动点时停止，使算力随任务难度变化；在 Sudoku、Maze、状态追踪和 ARC-AGI 上有效。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Latent and Explicit Reasoning with Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LOTUS loops a pretrained LM over padded latent blocks and supervises each latent position with its gold CoT-step token; at 3B scale it closes the gap to explicit CoT while cutting thought-phase latency 2.5x-6.9x.
tldr.zh: LOTUS 让预训练语言模型在填充的 latent 块上循环计算，并用对应 CoT 步骤的 gold token 逐位置监督每个 latent；在 3B 规模上它弥合了与显式 CoT 的差距，同时把思考阶段延迟降低 2.5x-6.9x。

papers.title: DiscoLoop: Looping Discrete Embeddings and Continuous Hidden States for Multi-hop Reasoning

tldr.en: Finds that a looped transformer's first loop leaves the two-hop bridge entity decodable but misaligned with its embedding; DiscoLoop adds a decoded-embedding channel between loops and outperforms looped baselines on multi-hop tasks and in pretraining.
tldr.zh: 发现循环 Transformer 第一遍循环后两跳问题的桥接实体已可解码，但隐藏状态与其 token embedding 不对齐；DiscoLoop 在循环之间增加一条解码后的 embedding 通道，在多跳任务和预训练中都优于循环基线。

papers.title: DeepLoop: Depth Scaling for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: DeepLoop derives a residual-scaling rule for looped Transformers that counts repeated visits to shared blocks; in GPT-2 small and medium looped language models it improves validation loss and downstream accuracy once blocks are revisited.
tldr.zh: DeepLoop 为循环 Transformer 推导出考虑共享块被重复访问的残差缩放规则；在 GPT-2 small 和 medium 规模的循环语言模型上，一旦块被重复使用，它就能改善验证损失和下游准确率。

papers.title: T^2MLR: Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence

tldr.en: T2MLR fuses a middle-layer state cached from the previous token into an earlier layer at the current token; it beats data- and parameter-matched Transformers, and recurrence over a middle block often beats full-layer recurrence.
tldr.zh: T2MLR 把上一个 token 缓存的中间层表示融合进当前 token 的较早层；它优于数据和参数匹配的 Transformer 基线，而且只在中间一段层上做循环往往优于全层循环。

papers.title: Looped Latent Attention: Cross-Loop KV Compression for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Looped Latent Attention, a post-training codec, stores the per-loop KV cache as compact latents and rebuilds loop-specific K/V on read; at matched cache budget it beats head-axis MLA, cross-layer sharing, KV quantization and final-loop reuse.
tldr.zh: Looped Latent Attention 是一种在模型训练后加装的 KV 缓存编解码器，把循环 Transformer 每遍的 KV 缓存存成紧凑的 latent，在注意力读取时再重建各遍的 K/V；在相同缓存预算下，它优于 head 维度的 MLA、跨层共享、KV 量化和复用末遍 KV。

papers.title: Loop the Loopies!

tldr.en: Loopie comprises two open-source looped MoE Transformers (20B with 2B active, 6B with 0.6B active) that repeat each layer in place; ablations show they outperform vanilla Transformers trained with the same compute budget.
tldr.zh: Loopie 包括两个开源的循环 MoE Transformer（20B 总参数、2B 激活，以及 6B 总参数、0.6B 激活），每一层原地重复执行；消融实验显示它们优于相同训练算力下的 vanilla Transformer 基线。

papers.title: Adaptive Depth in Looped Transformers: Diagnosing Learned Halting Gates and Trajectory Readouts

tldr.en: Splits adaptive depth in looped Transformers into trajectory formation and exit readout; fixed-prior depth supervision plus confidence readouts often matches or beats learned halting gates, and Ouro's pretrained gates are competitive but not uniformly Pareto-optimal.
tldr.zh: 把循环 Transformer 的自适应深度拆成轨迹形成和退出读出两部分；固定先验的深度监督配合置信度读出常常追平或超过学到的停止门控，Ouro 预训练的门控有竞争力但并非处处 Pareto 最优。

papers.title: When Does Recurrence Become an Algorithm? Convergence Selection in Weight-Tied Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Trains weight-tied looped transformers on group word problems; training installs a serial frontier that solves about n_train/T_train positions per loop, and weight tying, not expressivity, selects it over the parallel scans untied models learn.
tldr.zh: 在群的字问题（group word problem）上训练权重共享的循环 Transformer；训练会形成每遍约求解 n_train/T_train 个位置的串行前沿，选出这种算法的是权重共享这一结构先验而不是表达能力，未共享权重的标准深度 Transformer 则学到并行扫描。

papers.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Model

tldr.en: Nanbeige4.2-3B is pretrained from scratch on 28T tokens as a Looped Transformer that reuses its layer stack, then post-trained with SFT and RL; it outperforms larger models including Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B on agentic benchmarks.
tldr.zh: Nanbeige4.2-3B 采用复用整个层栈的 Looped Transformer，在 28T token 上从头预训练，再经 SFT 和 RL 后训练；在 agentic 基准上超过 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Gemma4-12B 等更大的模型。

papers.title: Full-bandwidth transformer

tldr.en: Fuses each step's top-layer state with the sampled token embedding through a gate and feeds it back as the next input; 1B models match or approach standard transformers trained on roughly 1.5x more tokens.
tldr.zh: 把每一步的顶层状态与采样 token 的 embedding 经门控融合后送回作为下一步输入；1B 模型的效果达到或接近用约 1.5x token 训练的标准 Transformer。

papers.title: Depth-adaptive Inference of Looped Language Models via Continuous Depth Batching

tldr.en: Continuous depth batching forms new batches between loop steps so looped LMs can serve tokens exiting at different depths; on Ouro 1.4B and Huginn 3.5B it realizes up to 99% of the estimated maximum speedup.
tldr.zh: Continuous depth batching 在循环步之间重新组 batch，使循环语言模型能同时处理在不同深度退出的 token；在 Ouro 1.4B 和 Huginn 3.5B 上最多实现估计最大加速的 99%。

papers.title: Retrofitting Recurrent Depth into a Pretrained Language Model: Installation, Extrapolation, Transfer, and Retention at Two Parameter Budgets

tldr.en: Splits Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct into prelude, weight-tied recurrent block and coda; with intermediate-step supervision it computes one task step per loop, extrapolates to roughly 1.5 times its supervised depth, and beats a scratchpad model 84% versus 72%.
tldr.zh: 把 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 拆成 prelude、权重共享的循环块和 coda；在中间步骤监督下，模型每遍循环完成一步任务，可外推到约 1.5 倍的监督深度，总体准确率以 84% 对 72% 胜过 scratchpad 训练的模型。

papers.title: Recirculation

tldr.en: Recirculation feeds part of a deep layer activation into a shallow layer of frozen pretrained transformers, adding recurrence over depth and tokens; adaptive recirculation on Gemma3 lowers perplexity and raises relative GSM8k accuracy by 21%.
tldr.zh: Recirculation 把深层激活的一部分送入冻结的预训练 transformer 的浅层，形成跨深度和跨 token 的循环；在 Gemma3 上，adaptive recirculation 降低了困惑度，并使 GSM8k 的相对准确率提高 21%。

papers.title: Think Shallow, Solve Deep: Controlling Recurrent Dynamics for Reliable Test-Time Depth

tldr.en: Shows that a trained recurrent operator's dynamical regime (settling, marginal or drifting) predicts whether extra test-time iterations help, preserve or degrade answers on algorithmic tasks; a terminal fixed-point objective controls the regime.
tldr.zh: 表明训练后循环算子的动力学状态（趋稳、临界或漂移）能预测在算法任务上增加测试时迭代会提升、保持还是损害答案；终端不动点目标可以控制这一状态。

papers.title: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers

note.en: Shown for the 200M scale (L = 12) used in all design ablations; the middle 6 of 12 layers run twice, so 18 layers execute per token. All four scales loop the middle 50% twice and place ⌊(L − m)/2⌋ layers before the span (looped layers 3-7, 4-9, 6-15 and 8-22 for L = 10, 12, 20 and 30). Inside the loop each sublayer's residual update is scaled by 1/r (here 1/2), and every layer execution computes its own Q, K and V; smaller heads at a higher GQA ratio keep the KV cache close to the Baseline's.
note.zh: 图示为所有设计消融所用的 200M 规模（L = 12）：12 层中间的 6 层跑两遍，每个 token 执行 18 层。四个规模都循环中间 50% 的层两遍，循环段之前放 ⌊(L − m)/2⌋ 层（L = 10、12、20、30 时循环的分别是第 3-7、4-9、6-15、8-22 层）。循环内每个子层的残差更新乘 1/r（这里是 1/2），每次执行都重新计算 Q、K、V；用更小的 head 和更高的 GQA 比例让 KV 接近 Baseline。

baseline.en: Unlooped MoE Transformer from the same internal family (top-8 routing, GQA), trained on identical token sequences in each of 16 grid cells (four scales; S = 0% and S ≈ 85%, 95%, 97%).
baseline.zh: 同一内部家族、不循环的 MoE Transformer（top-8 路由，GQA），在 16 个网格单元（四个规模；S = 0% 及 S ≈ 85%、95%、97%）里都用相同的 token 序列训练。

headline.en: With per-token FLOPs, total non-embedding parameters and KV cache matched (typical mismatch under 4%, 1% and 4%), SMELT reaches lower loss than the Baseline at every scale and sparsity level, and its separately fitted frontier saves 6.8-18.0% of training FLOPs at 10^20-10^21 FLOPs (14.7% at 10^21 and S ≈ 97%).
headline.zh: 每 token FLOPs、总非 embedding 参数和 KV 都对齐（典型偏差分别低于 4%、1%、4%）时，SMELT 在每个规模和稀疏度上的 loss 都低于 Baseline；分别拟合的前沿在 10^20-10^21 FLOPs 处省下 6.8-18.0% 的训练 FLOPs（10^21、S ≈ 97% 时为 14.7%）。

results.setting: 200M, L = 12, two passes, per-token FLOPs, total parameters and KV matched; contiguous middle span from 0 layers (Baseline) to all 12
results.metric: validation loss at S ≈ 85% / S ≈ 95% (lower is better)

note.en: DCLM Core does not track validation loss in this sweep; at S ≈ 95% it peaks at 67% span (31.78) and is 29.68 at 50%. The authors select the span on validation loss and train each configuration once.
note.zh: 这组实验中 DCLM Core 与验证 loss 走势不一致：S ≈ 95% 时 Core 在 67% 跨度最高（31.78），50% 跨度为 29.68。作者按验证 loss 选跨度，每个配置只训练一次。

results.setting: 200M, S ≈ 85%, middle 50% looped, physical depth 12, FLOPs, parameters and KV matched (more passes force a narrower model)
results.metric: validation loss / DCLM Core / DCLM Completion

results.setting: Separate fits of L(F, S, D) for each architecture on S ≈ 85%, 95% and 97% (72 + 72 endpoints spanning 1.3x10^19 to 2.2x10^21 training FLOPs)
results.metric: CE Gain, the share of training compute SMELT saves at equal frontier loss, at S ≈ 85% / 95% / 97%

note.en: Cell-bootstrap 95% intervals are wide, e.g. [1,22] at 10^20 FLOPs and S ≈ 85%; the 10^22 row lies beyond the fitted window and two of its three intervals reach 0.
note.zh: cell bootstrap 的 95% 区间很宽，例如 10^20 FLOPs、S ≈ 85% 时为 [1,22]；10^22 一行超出拟合范围，三个区间中有两个下限为 0。

results.setting: C = 10^21 FLOPs, S ≈ 95%; per-category intercepts fitted with the aggregate exponents

findings.en: At 200M with all budgets matched, looping the middle 6 of 12 layers gives lower validation loss than looping all 12 (1.9257 vs 1.9322 at S ≈ 85%, 1.8517 vs 1.8601 at S ≈ 95%), and every span tested beats the unlooped Baseline.
findings.zh: 200M、预算全部对齐时，循环 12 层中间的 6 层比循环全部 12 层的验证 loss 更低（S ≈ 85% 时 1.9257 对 1.9322，S ≈ 95% 时 1.8517 对 1.8601），且测试的每种跨度都优于不循环的 Baseline。

findings.en: Two passes beat three and four at matched FLOPs, parameters and KV (validation loss 1.9257 vs 1.9385 and 1.9360, DCLM Core 27.57 vs 27.15 and 27.30); the authors attribute the regression to the narrower model that extra passes force.
findings.zh: FLOPs、参数和 KV 对齐时，循环两遍优于三遍和四遍（验证 loss 1.9257 对 1.9385 和 1.9360，DCLM Core 27.57 对 27.15 和 27.30）；作者认为原因是多出的遍数迫使模型变窄。

findings.en: SMELT's fitted capacity and data exponents are both larger (a = 0.3892 vs 0.3703, c = 0.7011 vs 0.6594), giving frontier exponents of 0.250 vs 0.237; the irreducible losses differ by 0.005 nats, less than either fit's RMSE.
findings.zh: SMELT 拟合出的容量指数和数据指数都更大（a = 0.3892 对 0.3703，c = 0.7011 对 0.6594），前沿指数为 0.250 对 0.237；两者的不可约 loss 相差 0.005 nats，小于任一拟合的 RMSE。

findings.en: SMELT wins 96 of 96 matched pairs on DCLM Completion, 83 of 96 on DCLM Core and 29 of the 30 MMLU pairs whose Baseline is at least 10 points above chance, and it scores better than a Baseline at the same validation loss would (positive mean residual on all three at every scale).
findings.zh: SMELT 在 DCLM Completion 上赢下全部 96 对，DCLM Core 赢 83 对（共 96 对），MMLU 在 Baseline 高于随机水平至少 10 个点的 30 对中赢 29 对；而且比同等验证 loss 的 Baseline 预期得分更好（三项指标在每个规模上的平均残差都为正）。

findings.en: The gain is larger on longer samples and with in-context examples; the loss improvement on the four longest length buckets is 1.52x that on the four shortest, and the few-shot accuracy gap widens from 0.9 pp at k = 0 to 1.9 pp at k = 1, holding through k = 8.
findings.zh: 样本越长、in-context 示例越多，收益越大：最长四个长度桶的 loss 改善是最短四个的 1.52 倍；few-shot 准确率差距从 k = 0 时的 0.9 pp 扩大到 k = 1 时的 1.9 pp，并保持到 k = 8。

findings.en: The second visit shrinks the attention sink; for the 1.6B Dyck head, BOS attention mass falls from 0.60 to 0.02 and mass on demonstration answers rises from 0.24 to 0.85.
findings.zh: 第二遍会削弱 attention sink：1.6B 模型的 Dyck head 上，BOS 的注意力从 0.60 降到 0.02，示例答案上的注意力从 0.24 升到 0.85。

tldr.en: With per-token FLOPs, total parameters and KV cache matched, looping the middle half of an MoE Transformer twice lowers loss at four scales up to 54B non-embedding parameters and saves 6.8-18.0% of training FLOPs on the fitted frontier.
tldr.zh: 每 token FLOPs、总参数和 KV 都对齐时，把 MoE Transformer 中间一半的层循环两遍，在最大 54B 非 embedding 参数的四个规模上都降低了 loss，并在拟合前沿上省下 6.8-18.0% 的训练 FLOPs。

problem.en: Most looped-model gains are reported at fixed parameter count, where the looped model also spends more FLOPs and KV cache, so architecture and extra compute are conflated; the paper asks whether looping still helps when per-token FLOPs, total parameters and KV cache are all held fixed.
problem.zh: 多数循环模型的收益是在固定参数量下报告的，循环模型同时多花了 FLOPs 和 KV，结构优势和额外算力混在一起；论文研究每 token FLOPs、总参数和 KV 都固定时，循环是否仍然有用。

en: Pay for the extra pass by narrowing the hidden size (1280 to 1056 at 200M, S ≈ 95%), recover total parameters by adding experts (192 to 288 per layer), and use smaller heads at a higher GQA ratio to keep the KV cache within 4%.
Choose the recipe with three 200M ablations under these budgets; loop the middle 50% of layers twice, keep the Baseline's physical depth, and scale each looped sublayer's residual update by 1/r.

Train matched Baseline / SMELT pairs over 4 scales x 4 sparsity levels with six WSD decay branches each (up to about 215B tokens), and fit a separate Chinchilla-style law L(F, S, D) per architecture to compare compute-optimal frontiers.
zh: 用更窄的隐藏维度支付多出的一遍（200M、S ≈ 95% 时从 1280 降到 1056），增加专家补回总参数（每层从 192 增到 288），并用更小的 head 和更高的 GQA 比例把 KV 偏差控制在 4% 以内。
在这些预算约束下用三组 200M 消融确定配方：中间 50% 的层循环两遍，物理深度与 Baseline 相同，循环内每个子层的残差更新乘 1/r。
在 4 个规模 × 4 个稀疏度上训练成对的 Baseline / SMELT，每个 run 有六个 WSD 衰减分支（最长约 215B token），并为两种结构分别拟合 Chinchilla 式的 L(F, S, D)，比较 compute-optimal 前沿。

en: Active parameters and executed depth are not matched; at 200M and S ≈ 95% SMELT has 0.142B active parameters against the Baseline's 0.209B and executes 18 layers instead of 12 (Section 3.2; Tables 9-10).

The span, depth and loop-count ablations ran only at 200M, with one training run per configuration and the same loop count in training and evaluation; the authors note the best span or count may differ at larger scales (Section 3.3; Section 7).
Budget matching equates arithmetic FLOPs, parameters and KV-cache size, not wall-clock cost (Section 7).
The model family and training stack are proprietary and cannot be released, pretraining uses an internal corpus, and training contexts are 4096 tokens (Section 3.1; Appendix A).
SMELT shares the Baseline's optimizer, schedule and data; the Baseline configurations come from a tuned MoE family, and no separate tuning for SMELT is reported (Section 3.1; Appendix A).
zh: 激活参数和执行深度没有对齐：200M、S ≈ 95% 时 SMELT 的激活参数为 0.142B，Baseline 为 0.209B，执行 18 层而不是 12 层（Section 3.2；Tables 9-10）。
跨度、深度和遍数消融只在 200M 上做，每个配置只训练一次，训练和评测用同一个遍数；作者指出更大规模下最优跨度或遍数可能不同（Section 3.3；Section 7）。
预算对齐的是算术 FLOPs、参数和 KV 大小，不是墙钟时间（Section 7）。
模型家族和训练框架是专有的、无法公开，预训练用内部语料，训练上下文为 4096 token（Section 3.1；Appendix A）。
SMELT 与 Baseline 共用优化器、学习率调度和数据；Baseline 配置来自一个调过的 MoE 家族，论文没有提到为 SMELT 单独调参（Section 3.1；Appendix A）。

papers.glyph: L1-3 (3 layers) -> [L4-9 (6 layers)] x 2 -> L10-12 (3 layers); injection none; KV per-pass

papers.title: Looped Transformers under the Jacobian Lens: Does the Global Workspace Survive Recurrence?

tldr.en: Applies an extended Jacobian lens to Ouro-2.6B and Huginn-0125: both form a workspace in their iterated part, but Ouro rebuilds content every loop, while Huginn carries it forward and interventions act within about two recurrences.
tldr.zh: 把扩展后的 Jacobian lens 用于 Ouro-2.6B 和 Huginn-0125：两者都在迭代部分形成工作空间，但 Ouro 在每个 loop 中重建其内容，Huginn 则把内容向后续递归传递，而干预只在大约两次递归的窗口内起作用。

papers.title: RecurTrace: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Loop-Time Memory

tldr.en: Loops a middle block of an LM, adding attention over earlier loop states and an oracle-supervised halting head; on MathQA it reaches 56.9% with 2.0 loops on average, 2.2 points above the best fixed depth.
tldr.zh: 在语言模型中循环一个中间层块，加入对先前各遍状态的注意力（Loop Memory Attention）和由 oracle 监督的停止头；在 MathQA 上以平均 2.0 遍达到 56.9% 准确率，比最佳固定循环深度高 2.2 个点。

papers.title: Thinking with Looped Flows

tldr.en: Trains looped models with local denoising objectives at decreasing noise levels and infers by integrating a probability flow; across six reasoning benchmarks it outperforms prior looped models overall, reaching 58.8% test accuracy on ARC-AGI-1.
tldr.zh: 用噪声水平逐步降低的局部去噪目标训练循环模型，并把推理写成对概率流的积分；在六个推理基准上总体优于此前的循环模型，ARC-AGI-1 测试准确率达到 58.8%。

papers.title: LoopSpec: Pipelined Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LoopSpec, a training-free self-speculative decoder for looped Transformers, drafts tokens from early recurrent states and overlaps drafting with verification; it stays lossless under greedy and sampling decoding and reaches up to 6.83× speedup.
tldr.zh: LoopSpec 是面向循环 Transformer 的免训练自投机解码方法，从较早循环深度的状态中取 draft token，并把后续 token 的起草与当前 token 的验证流水线重叠；在 greedy 和采样解码下均无损，最高加速 6.83×。

papers.title: WaveFront Decoding: Parallelized Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Wavefront Decoding is a training-free self-speculative decoder for looped language models that co-batches shallow drafting and full-depth verification in the same recurrent-block calls, reaching 2.42x speedup on Ouro-2.6B and 3.54x on Huginn-3.5B over autoregressive decoding.
tldr.zh: Wavefront Decoding 是面向循环语言模型的免训练自推测解码方法，在同一次批量循环块调用中同时做浅层起草和全深度验证，相对自回归解码在 Ouro-2.6B 上加速 2.42x、在 Huginn-3.5B 上加速 3.54x。

papers.title: FlashLoop: Fast and Memory-Efficient Looped Transformers via Lazy Updates

tldr.en: FlashLoop, a training-free inference framework, cuts cross-loop redundancy in looped Transformers with token-sparse updates, sparse attention and KV-residual quantization, giving up to 1.64x speedup and 6x less KV-cache memory while largely preserving accuracy.
tldr.zh: FlashLoop 是一个无需训练的推理框架，通过 token 稀疏更新、稀疏注意力和 KV 残差量化减少循环 Transformer 的跨遍冗余，在基本保持精度的同时带来最高 1.64x 的加速和 6x 的 KV 缓存内存降低。

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points

tldr.en: Shows that near fixed points looped LMs can skip recurrence paths in training, decoding, prefill and RL; its learned depth prior and orthogonal input injection lower perplexity over existing choices from 100M to 1.6B.
tldr.zh: 说明循环语言模型的状态接近不动点时，训练、解码、prefill 和 RL 都可以跳过递归路径；文中学习的深度先验和正交输入注入在 100M 到 1.6B 参数规模上都比已有做法困惑度更低。

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design

tldr.en: Isolates loop placement, input injection and recurrent-state design in matched from-scratch looped LMs; a prelude-recurrent-coda Huginn-style design outperforms Ouro across all ten benchmarks at 730M parameters and 336B tokens, and the advantage transfers to MoE.
tldr.zh: 在从头训练、参数规模、逻辑深度和 token 预算都匹配的循环语言模型中分别考察循环位置、输入注入和递归状态设计；在 730M 参数、336B token 规模下，完整的 Huginn 式 prelude-recurrent-coda 设计在全部十个基准上优于 Ouro，且这一优势可迁移到 MoE 模型。

papers.title: One Model, Two Paths: Balancing Single-Pass and Looped Performance in Language Models

tldr.en: Adapts a pretrained model to support both single-pass and looped inference by reusing middle-layer weights, and shows joint weighted losses with frozen-model guidance reduce single-pass degradation while keeping looped gains over continued training.
tldr.zh: 通过复用中间层权重让预训练模型同时支持单遍和循环推理，并表明在两个输出上加权联合训练、配合冻结原模型的引导，可减少单遍性能下降，同时保留循环相对普通继续训练的收益。

papers.title: LoopGR: Parameter-Efficient Scaling for Generative Recommendation via Recurrent Depth

tldr.en: For generative recommendation, LoopGR alternates a shared generative decoder with a lightweight context updater over recurrent depth and self-distills a low-budget student; it beats an encoder-decoder baseline while reducing model size by up to 52%.
tldr.zh: LoopGR 面向生成式推荐，在循环深度上交替使用共享的生成式 decoder 和轻量的上下文更新器，并自蒸馏出低预算的学生模型；相比编码器-解码器基线效果更好，同时模型规模最多减少 52%。

papers.title: ScaleRLT: Exact Log-Probabilities and Fast Deferred Rollouts for Reinforcement Learning on Looped Transformers

tldr.en: ScaleRLT removes the log-probability mismatch between deferred rollouts and the learner's dense pass in RL on looped transformers, using a stop-gradient hybrid that replays the rollout schedule bit for bit and keeps the dense gradient.
tldr.zh: ScaleRLT 针对循环 Transformer 的 RL，消除延迟 rollout 与学习器 dense 前向之间的 log-probability 不一致：用一个 stop-gradient 混合项，数值上逐位重放 rollout 的调度，梯度仍取 dense 前向的梯度。

papers.title: Recency Is the Wrong Axis: A Negative Result on Windowed Deepest-Plane KV Caching in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Tests a KV policy for looped models that keeps every loop's plane for recent positions and shares the deepest plane elsewhere; across three models, sharing cost depends on late-loop convergence and position, not recency.
tldr.zh: 检验一种循环模型 KV 缓存策略：最近位置保留每个循环的 KV 平面，其余位置共享最深一遍的平面；在三个模型上，共享代价取决于后期循环平面的收敛程度和共享的位置，而非是否最近。

papers.title: Recursive CLIP: Vision-Language Distillation with Looped Transformer Blocks

tldr.en: Trains and distills CLIP models with recursive encoders that apply N transformer blocks M times at fixed ViT-B depth; CLIP tolerates substantial recurrent block reuse, though the effect depends on the encoder and downstream task.
tldr.zh: 训练并蒸馏编码器为递归结构的 CLIP 模型，用 N 个 transformer 块重复 M 次并保持 ViT-B 的深度；CLIP 能承受大量递归块复用，但效果取决于编码器和下游任务。

papers.title: Cross-Loop Query Handoff: How Later Loops Redirect Two-Hop Retrieval in the Ouro Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Transplants attention queries between loops of Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B; loop-3 queries injected into loop 1 rescue 90% and 97% of synthetic two-hop loop-1 failures that loop 3 fixes, versus 24% and 21% with shuffled donors.
tldr.zh: 在 Ouro-1.4B 和 Ouro-2.6B 中跨循环移植注意力 query；把第 3 遍的 query 注入第 1 遍，可挽救 90% 和 97% 第 1 遍答错而第 3 遍答对的合成两跳问题，打乱的供体只有 24% 和 21%。

papers.title: StateLoop: Persistent State for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: StateLoop gives each token a gated persistent state carried across looped-Transformer iterations and projected back into the backbone output; it lowers Pile perplexity versus vanilla looping, with a gap that grows with trained loop depth.
tldr.zh: StateLoop 为每个 token 维护一个门控的持久状态，跨循环迭代保留信息并投影回加到 backbone 输出上；相比普通循环模型 Pile 困惑度更低，且优势随训练时的循环深度增大。

papers.title: LoopFold: Parallelizing Recurrent Depth in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LoopFold runs several recurrent depths of a looped Transformer in parallel batches, using a predictor for later-loop inputs and a corrector for their outputs; versus a nine-loop vanilla model it cuts decoding latency by 46%.
tldr.zh: LoopFold 把循环 Transformer 多个循环深度的计算折叠进并行批次，用预测器估计后续循环的输入、用校正器修正其输出；与九遍循环的普通模型相比，解码延迟降低 46%。

papers.title: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report

tldr.en: Metis-1.6 technical report on Praxis and Logos, two from-scratch models that run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention MoE stack twice per token; Logos averages 52.93 across 40 post-trained benchmarks, and the report documents training failures.
tldr.zh: Metis-1.6 技术报告介绍从头训练的 Praxis 和 Logos 两个模型，它们对每个 token 将 Mamba-2 与注意力混合的 MoE 堆栈运行两遍；Logos 在 40 个后训练基准上平均 52.93 分，报告还记录了训练中的失败。

papers.title: Compute Has Shape: Self-Morphing the Internal Computation of Frozen LLMs

tldr.en: SelfMorph trains a selector that picks, per input, whether a frozen LLM keeps its forward path, repeats a layer span or branches hidden states; this gives an 8.06% mean relative improvement on five in-distribution benchmarks.
tldr.zh: SelfMorph 训练一个选择器，按输入决定冻结的 LLM 走原始前向路径、重复执行一段层，还是在局部分叉隐藏状态；在五个分布内基准上平均相对提升 8.06%。

papers.title: Deeper Backpropagation or More Updates? Training Looped Language Models Across Budgets

tldr.en: Compares shorter and longer truncated-backprop windows for training looped language models at roughly equal training time; the advantage of shorter windows shrinks as training budgets grow, so the preferred window can change.
tldr.zh: 在大致相同的训练时间下比较循环语言模型训练中较短与较长的截断反传窗口；随着训练预算增大，较短窗口的优势缩小，更优的窗口可能随之改变。

papers.title: CopyLoop: Fast Looped Transformer Decoding via Context Copying and Shallow Screening

tldr.en: CopyLoop, a training-free decoding algorithm for looped Transformers, proposes multi-token suffixes from repeated context, screens them at shallow recurrent depth and verifies at full depth, reaching 2.98x--10.70x speedups on Base models.
tldr.zh: CopyLoop 是面向循环 Transformer 的免训练解码算法，从重复上下文中提出多 token 后缀，先在浅层循环深度筛选、再在完整深度验证，在 Base 模型上取得 2.98x--10.70x 的加速。

papers.title: How to Loop Your Transformer: Loop Scaling, Specialization, and Parallel Inference

tldr.en: In looped decoders up to 1B parameters, full-stack looping is best at fixed parameters and middle-block looping at fixed training FLOPs; per-loop low-rank adapters help, and a normalization fix recovers Parallel Loop Transformer quality.
tldr.zh: 在最多 1B 参数的循环 decoder 上，固定参数量时循环整栈最好，固定训练 FLOPs 时循环中间块更好；每遍的低秩 adapter 有帮助，一个归一化上的改动能恢复 Parallel Loop Transformer 的质量。

papers.title: UpLoop: Training Looped Transformers via Upcycling at No Extra Pretraining Compute

tldr.en: Grows a shallow Transformer by copying layers and spends the saved compute on looping a shared middle block, at matched parameters, tokens and FLOPs; the 1.3B model's 22-task average rises from 22.99 to 27.52.
tldr.zh: 通过复制已学到的层把浅层 Transformer 逐步加深，并把早期省下的算力用于反复执行共享的中间块，参数量、训练 token 数和训练 FLOPs 均与稠密基线一致；1.3B 模型在 22 个下游任务上的平均分从 22.99 提升到 27.52。

papers.title: ElTab: Elastically Looped Tabular Transformers

tldr.en: ElTab trains one looped tabular transformer with supervision at randomly sampled early exits; on 30 OpenML datasets it matches six depth-specific looped models and a 12-layer TabPFN-style baseline with 25% fewer inference FLOPs.
tldr.zh: ElTab 在随机采样的 early exit 处加监督，训练出单个循环表格 Transformer；在 30 个 OpenML 数据集上，它与六个按深度单独训练的循环模型相当，并以少 25% 的推理 FLOPs 追平 12 层 TabPFN 式基线。

papers.title: Where KV-Cache Error Lives in Looped Language Models: A Diagnostic Study of Ouro and Huginn

tldr.en: Studies how KV and shared-weight quantization error changes next-token distributions in looped LMs Ouro and Huginn-0125; per unit of error, values carry 94% of diagonal Fisher mass, but keys dominate measured KL.
tldr.zh: 研究 KV 与共享权重的量化误差如何改变循环语言模型 Ouro 和 Huginn-0125 的下一 token 分布；按单位误差计，value 占对角 Fisher 质量的 94%，但实测 KL 主要来自 key。

papers.title: There Is No Free Loop: When Does Looping a Trained Model Pay for Its Inference Compute?

tldr.en: Adds loops to pretrained Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 models (0.8B to 9B) and compares them with equal-parameter and equal-FLOPs unlooped baselines; only the looped 0.8B model beats both, so post-pretraining loops pay only for small models.
tldr.zh: 在 0.8B 到 9B 的预训练 Qwen3 和 Qwen3.5 模型中加入循环，并与等参数、等 FLOPs 的不循环基线比较；只有循环后的 0.8B 模型同时胜过两者，说明预训练后再加循环只对小模型划算。

papers.title: How Does Chain-of-Thought Supervision Teach Models to Reason? A Theoretical Analysis

tldr.en: Studies an in-context linear-regression weight predictor trained on gradient-descent trajectories and run recursively beyond them; long-horizon reasoning has phase transitions in context length and training CoT budget, and overthinking splits into error accumulation and amplification.
tldr.zh: 研究一个在梯度下降轨迹上训练、测试时递归应用并超出训练步数的线性回归上下文权重预测模型；长程推理的成败随上下文长度和训练 CoT 总量出现相变，过度思考分为误差累积和误差放大两种机制。

papers.title: When Does Adaptive Halting Win? Selection Rules Matter in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: On a frozen Ouro-1.4B, pre-registered tests show the winner between a trained stability probe and Ouro's exit gate flips with the operating-point selection rule; the probe shows no demonstrated advantage over an untrained KL baseline.
tldr.zh: 在冻结的 Ouro-1.4B 上，预注册实验显示，训练的稳定性探针与 Ouro 原生退出门控孰优孰劣会随工作点选择规则而反转；该探针相对未训练的 KL 基线没有显示出优势。

papers.title: Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver

tldr.en: Trains a looped transformer whose update operator, independent of the iteration count, keeps refining multi-view geometry from its current state, so one solver handles offline and incremental reconstruction, relocalization and streaming without task-specific training.
tldr.zh: 训练一个与迭代次数无关的循环 transformer 更新算子，从当前状态继续求解多视角几何，使同一个求解器无需针对任务训练即可用于离线重建、增量重建、重定位和流式处理。

papers.title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime

tldr.en: Library of Layers uses a router to choose and order blocks from a global library at inference, covering dense, depth-recurrent and MoE designs; it is competitive with all three when pretrained on text.
tldr.zh: Library of Layers 用路由器在推理时从全局块库中选择并排列要执行的 Transformer 块，涵盖 dense、深度循环和 MoE 架构；在文本上预训练时与这三类基线表现相当。

papers.title: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT

tldr.en: Dory1.0-4B is a looped nGPT language model with elastic depth, pre-trained on 6 trillion tokens; more loops raise accuracy, and caching only last-loop KV keeps most gains at a non-looped KV footprint.
tldr.zh: Dory1.0-4B 是基于 nGPT 的弹性深度循环语言模型，预训练 6 万亿 token；循环次数越多准确率越高，只缓存最后一遍的 KV 时，KV 占用与不循环模型相同，并保留大部分收益。

papers.title: LoopKV: Loop-Aware KV Cache Compression for Serving Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Chooses 4-bit, 2-bit or final-loop KV reuse for each (loop, layer) cell of Ouro from an offline profile; serving Ouro-1.4B, the LoopKV-M plan stores 35% less KV than KIVI-4 and sustains 1.7-2.2x its goodput.
tldr.zh: 依据离线 profile 为 Ouro 的每个（循环，层）KV 单元选择 4-bit、2-bit 存储或复用末遍 KV；服务 Ouro-1.4B 时，LoopKV-M 方案比 KIVI-4 少存 35% 的 KV，goodput 为其 1.7-2.2x。

papers.title: Best-of-Depth: Learning Exploratory Dynamics in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Best-of-Depth trains a looped Transformer's recurrent trajectory as a candidate set by minimizing prediction loss across depths; on N-Queens, coverage reaches 91.03% versus 45.75% for final-depth training.
tldr.zh: Best-of-Depth 通过在各个深度上最小化预测损失，把循环 Transformer 的递归轨迹当作候选集来训练；在 N-Queens 上覆盖率达到 91.03%，而只训练最终深度为 45.75%。

papers.title: What Sets the Serving Speed of Looped Language Models? Measurements and Optimizations Graded by Exactness

tldr.en: Measures serving of looped LMs Ouro and Huginn-0125, grading optimizations by exactness; the many small kernels per token set the cost, and fusing them behind rounding fences raises throughput 1.11-1.59x with identical outputs.
tldr.zh: 测量循环语言模型 Ouro 和 Huginn-0125 的服务性能，并按精确程度为优化分级；每 token 的大量小 kernel 才是主要开销，在舍入屏障后融合这些 kernel 使吞吐提高 1.11-1.59x，且输出完全一致。

papers.title: ARLoop: Fully-Open Pre-trained Looped Transformers with Attention Residuals

tldr.en: ARLoop gives each layer of a looped transformer attention over earlier outputs across depth; sliding-window depth attention matches full history, and a 1.2B model trained on 0.5T tokens beats Huginn-3.5B on all evaluated tasks.
tldr.zh: ARLoop 让循环 Transformer 的每一层对深度方向上更早的输出做注意力；滑窗深度注意力与完整历史效果相当，在 0.5T token 上训练的 1.2B 模型在所有评测任务上都超过 Huginn-3.5B。

papers.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LoopVQ vector-quantizes the KV cache of looped transformers, coding channels of several loop steps jointly; with Ouro and Huginn at 0.5 bits per element, it outperforms KV vector quantization methods built for standard LLMs.
tldr.zh: LoopVQ 对循环 Transformer 的 KV cache 做向量量化，把多个循环步的通道联合编码；在 Ouro 和 Huginn 上、每元素 0.5 bit 时，它优于为标准 LLM 设计的 KV 向量量化方法。

papers.title: Give the Drafter a Second Chance to Guess: Parallel Reconsideration for Speculative Decoding

tldr.en: Lets a speculative-decoding drafter deepen uncertain guesses with extra passes of its shared block, run in parallel with the one-pass draft; this improves acceptance length by 5.3% to 10.2% and speedup by 3.5% to 9.2%.
tldr.zh: 让推测解码的 drafter 对没把握的猜测用共享块多跑几遍以加深特征，并与单遍草稿并行执行；接受长度提升 5.3% 到 10.2%，加速比提升 3.5% 到 9.2%。

papers.title: Loop Before You Leap: What Recurrent Depth Can and Cannot Buy in Data-Limited Pretraining

tldr.en: Compares standard and looped Transformers under a 100M-word budget; text-only, a 12-layer stack repeated four times beats a 48-layer Transformer by 5.4 BLiMP points, but recurrence does not clearly mitigate the multimodal-training drop.
tldr.zh: 在 100M 词的预算下比较标准与循环 Transformer；纯文本时，12 层堆叠重复四次比 48 层 Transformer 高 5.4 个 BLiMP 点，但循环没有明显缓解多模态训练带来的下降。

papers.title: LooM: Loop-Invariant Memory for Causal Encoder-Decoder Language Models

tldr.en: Loops the decoder layers of a causal encoder-decoder, storing each token's KV only on its first visit; one model covers 3 to 21 layer executions per token and, with enough loops, beats a single-pass baseline.
tldr.zh: 在因果 encoder-decoder 中循环 decoder 层，每个 token 的 KV 只在首次经过时写入；一个模型覆盖每 token 3 到 21 次层执行，循环足够多时优于单遍基线。

papers.title: Not All Loops Cost the Same: Phase-Dependent Depth for Serving Looped Transformers

passes.test: S for decode, P <= S for prefill, at most 32

note.en: Shown for OLMo r32, a recurrent OLMo-2 retrofit with 4/6/4 prelude/core/coda layers at width 2,048 (the r16 checkpoint has the same layout and was trained at 16 loops); Huginn-0125 has 2/4/2 layers at width 5,280. LoopDuet trains nothing. Ordinary prompt positions run P core loops, while every prompt-chunk endpoint and every decoded token runs S. Serving keeps one shared KV plane per core layer that each loop overwrites, so later queries read the last computed KV of positions that stopped early.
note.zh: 图示为 OLMo r32：OLMo-2 的循环改造版，prelude/core/coda 为 4/6/4 层，宽度 2,048（r16 布局相同，训练时 16 遍）；Huginn-0125 为 2/4/2 层，宽度 5,280。LoopDuet 不训练模型。普通 prompt 位置跑 P 遍 core，每个 prompt chunk 的末位置和每个 decode token 跑 S 遍。服务时每个 core 层只有一份共享 KV，每遍覆盖写入，后续 query 读到的是提前停下的位置最后算出的 KV。

baseline.en: Uniform-depth serving (S, S) of the same checkpoint in the same vLLM engine, with the same prompts, KV layout, precision and execution mode; (32, 32) is the full-depth reference, and fixed prefilling depths at the same S are the controls under load.
baseline.zh: 同一 checkpoint 在同一 vLLM 引擎中按均匀深度 (S, S) 服务，prompt、KV 布局、精度和执行模式都相同；(32, 32) 是满深度参照，负载实验的对照是同一 S 下的固定 prefill 深度。

headline.en: On full HotpotQA with one A100-80GB, Huginn (32, 16) gives 1.19x the throughput of (20, 20), the fastest tested uniform setting meeting the same accuracy criterion, and (14, 8) gains 6.04 EM points over uniform (8, 8) at 97% of its throughput. Under load, adapting OLMo's prefilling depth gains 0.92-1.35 EM points over the most accurate tested fixed depths at the same 100% one-second TTFT attainment.
headline.zh: 在完整 HotpotQA、单张 A100-80GB 上，Huginn (32, 16) 的吞吐是 (20, 20) 的 1.19 倍，后者是满足同一准确率标准的最快均匀设置；(14, 8) 保留均匀 (8, 8) 97% 的吞吐，EM 高 6.04 分。负载下，自适应调整 OLMo 的 prefill 深度，在一秒 TTFT 达标率同为 100% 时，比测过的最准固定深度高 0.92-1.35 EM 分。

results.setting: Huginn-0125, full HotpotQA distractor dev set (7,405 examples), one A100-SXM4-80GB, vLLM 0.14.1, bf16, no prefix caching, C = 64
Same HotpotQA serving setup, OLMo r32 with four-paragraph prompts
HotpotQA, C = 64; each LoopDuet setting against a uniform setting whose throughput differs by at most 10%
HotpotQA, C = 64, decoding depth S held fixed; LoopDuet (S, P) against uniform (S, S)
results.metric: speedup / EM uniform → LoopDuet / measured speedup as a fraction of the layer-pass ratio

results.setting: OLMo r32, S = 4, all HotpotQA examples, open-loop C = 128; queue controller with P in [2, 4]
GSM8K, all 1,319 test examples, five demonstrations, greedy decoding; changes from each checkpoint's (S, S) control
results.metric: accuracy change (pp), uniform (P, P) / LoopDuet (S, P)

findings.en: The first output token needs full depth: for Huginn on HotpotQA at S = 32 with other prompt positions at P = 16, running the final prompt position at 16 loops instead of 32 lowers EM by 1.74 points relative to (32, 16) and by 1.97 points relative to (32, 32).
findings.zh: 首个输出 token 需要满深度：Huginn 在 HotpotQA 上 S = 32、其余 prompt 位置 P = 16 时，把最后一个 prompt 位置从 32 遍降到 16 遍，EM 比 (32, 16) 低 1.74 分，比 (32, 32) 低 1.97 分。

findings.en: Split budgets do not always win: Huginn (24, 12) gives 31.60 EM at 2.43 req/s, while uniform (12, 12) gives 32.05 EM at 2.48 req/s.
findings.zh: 拆分预算不一定更好：Huginn (24, 12) 为 31.60 EM、2.43 req/s，均匀的 (12, 12) 为 32.05 EM、2.48 req/s。

findings.en: For OLMo r32 on HotpotQA, EM stays between 37.95 and 38.49 across all six tested settings, so uniform depth four, the fastest at 56.46 req/s and 0.54 points below (32, 32), is chosen as the controller's starting point.
findings.zh: OLMo r32 在 HotpotQA 上测的六种设置 EM 都在 37.95 到 38.49 之间，因此选最快的均匀 4 遍（56.46 req/s，比 (32, 32) 低 0.54 分）作为控制器的起点。

findings.en: Useful prefilling depth is task dependent: on ARC at S = 11, raising OLMo r32's P from 4 to 8 moves the accuracy change from -1.54 to +0.85 points, and Huginn (14, 8) stays 4.44 points below (14, 14).
findings.zh: 合适的 prefill 深度因任务而异：ARC 上 S = 11 时，OLMo r32 的 P 从 4 提到 8，准确率变化从 -1.54 变为 +0.85 分；Huginn (14, 8) 仍比 (14, 14) 低 4.44 分。

findings.en: The savings survive batching: Huginn (32, 16) keeps 1.84x, 1.87x and 1.88x speedups over (32, 32) at engine-step token budgets of 4,096, 8,192 and 16,384 (C = 128), and 1.87x at C = 32, 64 and 128.
findings.zh: 节省在 batching 下依然存在：C = 128 时，engine step 的 token 预算为 4,096、8,192、16,384，Huginn (32, 16) 相对 (32, 32) 的加速为 1.84、1.87、1.88 倍；C = 32、64、128 时都是 1.87 倍。

tldr.en: Serve looped Transformers with fewer core loops for ordinary prompt tokens than for the last prompt token and the decoded tokens, run the deep tail as a compact batch in vLLM, and lower prefilling depth when the queue grows.
tldr.zh: 服务循环 Transformer 时，普通 prompt token 少跑几遍，最后一个 prompt token 和 decode token 跑满；在 vLLM 里把需要继续循环的位置收成紧凑 batch，排队变长时再降低 prefill 深度。

problem.en: Serving a looped model with one loop count for all tokens ties prefill cost to decode depth. With long prompts and short answers (OLMo HotpotQA prompts average 796 tokens and answers about 4.7), prompt positions account for over 99% of layer applications, so keeping deep decoding repeats deep computation over the whole prompt.
problem.zh: 用同一个循环遍数服务所有 token，会把 prefill 成本和 decode 深度绑在一起。prompt 长、回答短时（OLMo 的 HotpotQA prompt 平均 796 token，回答约 4.7 token），prompt 位置占了 99% 以上的层计算，保留深 decode 就意味着整段 prompt 都要跑深循环。

en: Choose decode depth S and prefill depth P <= S jointly from measured quality-throughput trade-offs; ordinary prompt positions stop after P core loops, while every prompt-chunk endpoint and every decoded token runs S.

In vLLM, after P loops the engine gathers each request's final query into a compact B x d batch for the remaining S - P loops and scatters it back before the coda; prompt context stays in one shared KV plane per core layer, so existing weights and attention kernels are reused.
A queue-age controller maps the oldest first-token wait from 0.25 s to 1 s linearly onto [P_min, P_max] before each engine step, keeping S fixed (main setting S = 4, P in {2, 3, 4}).
A recurrent-state distance (90th percentile over ordinary prompt tokens, threshold about 0.24) screens candidate P values before task-accuracy checks.
zh: 根据实测的质量-吞吐权衡联合选 decode 深度 S 和 prefill 深度 P（P <= S）；普通 prompt 位置跑 P 遍 core 后停下，每个 prompt chunk 的末位置和每个 decode token 跑满 S 遍。
在 vLLM 里，跑完 P 遍后把每个请求的最后一个 query 收集成 B x d 的紧凑 batch，跑剩下的 S - P 遍，再在 coda 前散回原位；prompt 上下文留在每个 core 层一份的共享 KV 里，直接复用现有权重和 attention kernel。
队列年龄控制器在每个 engine step 前，把最早一个请求等待首 token 的时间从 0.25 秒到 1 秒线性映射到 [P_min, P_max]，S 保持不变（主实验 S = 4，P 取 {2, 3, 4}）。
用循环状态距离（普通 prompt token 的 90 分位，阈值约 0.24）先筛出候选 P，再用任务准确率验证。

en: Training-free serving study of existing checkpoints only (Huginn-0125 and the recurrent OLMo-2 retrofits r16 and r32); every tested depth is at most 32 loops (16 for OLMo r16).

Tasks are GSM8K, HotpotQA (distractor dev set) and ARC-Challenge, with model-specific prompts (OLMo four paragraphs and one demonstration under a 1,000-token cap; Huginn ten paragraphs and two demonstrations); the authors call these within-model comparisons, not a ranking between models.
All timings use one A100-SXM4-80GB, vLLM 0.14.1, bf16 and no prefix caching; the joint-depth comparison uses one execution per configuration at C = 64.
Gains depend on the workload: on GSM8K, longer responses give wall-time ratios of 0.98-1.01 across four serving pairs despite layer-pass ratios of 1.52-2.71.

Decoding reads prompt KV from the last loop each position computed, an approximation to full-depth context that the authors evaluate through task accuracy; the controller has no correctness feedback and works within a depth range chosen offline.
On the 20/80 req/s burst trace the controller reaches 87.5% one-second TTFT attainment, against 100% for fixed P = 2.
zh: 只在现有 checkpoint 上做免训练的服务研究（Huginn-0125 和 OLMo-2 循环改造版 r16、r32）；所有测试深度都不超过 32 遍（OLMo r16 不超过 16 遍）。
任务为 GSM8K、HotpotQA（distractor 开发集）和 ARC-Challenge，prompt 按模型分别构造（OLMo 四段材料加一个示例，上限 1,000 token；Huginn 十段材料加两个示例）；作者说明这些是同一模型内的对比，不是模型间排名。
所有计时都在单张 A100-SXM4-80GB、vLLM 0.14.1、bf16、不开 prefix caching 下进行；联合深度对比在 C = 64 下每个配置只跑一次。
收益取决于负载：GSM8K 回答更长，四组服务对比的墙钟时间比只有 0.98-1.01，而层计算比为 1.52-2.71。
decode 读到的 prompt KV 来自各位置最后算到的那一遍，是对满深度上下文的近似，作者通过任务准确率来评估；控制器没有正确性反馈，只在离线选定的深度范围内调整。
在 20/80 req/s 的突发流量下，控制器的一秒 TTFT 达标率为 87.5%，固定 P = 2 为 100%。

papers.title: Loopback Transformer: Towards a Unified View of Residual Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Loopback Transformer reads each shared-block update separately, using geometric decay for total update weight and attention to allocate it; it reaches lower validation loss than standard Transformers with 40-75% of their Transformer parameters.
tldr.zh: Loopback Transformer 把共享块每次的更新量单独读出，用几何衰减设定更新总权重、用注意力分配权重；它用标准 Transformer 40-75% 的 Transformer 参数达到更低的验证损失。

papers.title: BRIDGE: Bridging the Semantic Quantization Gap for Generative Recommendation

tldr.en: For generative recommendation, BRIDGE adds latent reasoning, self-distillation and effort-aware recurrence, which runs a shared loop decoder more times at early Semantic ID levels; it improves Recall@10 and NDCG@10 on three Amazon benchmarks.
tldr.zh: 面向生成式推荐，BRIDGE 加入隐式推理、自蒸馏和按难度分配的循环，后者在靠前的 Semantic ID 层级上让共享的循环解码器执行更多次；在三个 Amazon 基准上提升了 Recall@10 和 NDCG@10。

papers.title: Extending Reasoning in Typed Decision Models via Looping

tldr.en: RELOAD fine-tunes pretrained encoders or decoders with a damped loop over their middle block; looping improves accuracy and calibration, mostly on reasoning chains longer than in training, where encoders gain up to 23 points.
tldr.zh: RELOAD 在预训练 encoder 或 decoder 的中间块上加阻尼循环并微调；循环提升了准确率和校准，主要体现在比训练中更长的推理链上，encoder 最多提升 23 个点。

papers.title: Beyond Quadratic Attention: Separable Gaussian Operators for ODE Vision Transformers

tldr.en: Replaces ViT self-attention with a separable sum-of-Gaussians operator, globally Lipschitz with fixed kernels, across discrete, looped and Neural ODE ViTs; in the looped setting it raises CIFAR-100 Top-1 accuracy by 5.4-8.1 points.
tldr.zh: 用可分离的高斯和算子替换 ViT 的自注意力（固定核时全局 Lipschitz），并在离散、循环和 Neural ODE 三种 ViT 中测试；在循环设置下 CIFAR-100 Top-1 准确率提高 5.4-8.1 个点。

papers.title: AlterNet: Adaptive-Depth Mixture-of-Experts with Learned Halting for Elastic Inference

tldr.en: AlterNet loops over a shared pool of shallow MoE experts, picked by a depth-aware router, with per-expert halt heads for early stopping, so depth adapts and can be cut without retraining; results are preliminary.
tldr.zh: AlterNet 在共享的浅层 MoE 专家池上循环计算，由感知深度的路由器挑选专家，用每个专家的停止头提前结束，使深度可自适应，且无需重新训练即可降低；结果仍是初步的。

papers.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: Your Recurrent Reasoner Should Be an Energy-Based Model

tldr.en: Learns an energy over latent reasoning states and makes each loop a gradient step on it, giving a stopping signal; reaches 99.9% accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme with 345× less inference compute than the next-best model.
tldr.zh: 学习潜在推理状态上的能量函数，把每次循环写成对该能量的一步梯度下降，并由此得到停止信号；在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到 99.9% 准确率，推理算力比次优模型少 345×。

papers.title: WiFo-R: Wireless Foundation Model with Recurrent Channel Representation

tldr.en: Builds a wireless channel foundation model whose parameter-shared recurrent updates refine CSI features and add latent tokens; multi-depth pretraining trains intermediate states to reconstruct CSI, and selectable depth improves the accuracy-complexity trade-off.
tldr.zh: 构建无线信道基础模型，用参数共享的循环更新细化 CSI 特征并加入新的潜在 token；多深度预训练让中间状态也能重建 CSI，可选的循环深度改善了精度与复杂度的权衡。

papers.title: Depth as a Candidate Source: Portfolio Allocation for Recurrent Test-Time Scaling in Large Language Models

tldr.en: Shows deeper recurrence in a frozen Huginn can lose correct answers found at shallower depths, and proposes Depth Portfolio Allocation, which spreads a test-time budget across depths and expands oracle coverage at matched candidate counts.
tldr.zh: 发现在冻结的 Huginn 上加深循环可能丢掉较浅深度已找到的正确解，并提出 Depth Portfolio Allocation，把测试时预算分配到多个深度上，在候选数相同时扩大 oracle 覆盖率。

papers.title: Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache: Recurrent Depth for Causal Encoder-Decoders

note.en: 12-layer causal encoder-decoder (CED) in the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash layout: every layer has SWA-128; L2 is the encoder's only global KV source and L6 projects the global KV shared by the decoder. The loop repeats L2-5.
note.zh: 12 层因果编码器-解码器（CED），沿用 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的布局：每层都有 128 窗口 SWA；L2 是 encoder 唯一的全局 KV 源，L6 投影出 decoder 共用的全局 KV。循环 L2-5。

baseline.en: Unlooped CED with the same 12-layer layout; dense, decoder-loop and YOCO-U-style variants are also compared.
baseline.zh: 同样 12 层布局、不循环的 CED；另有 dense、decoder 循环和 YOCO-U 式对照。

headline.en: At 150M, the encoder loop lowers BPB from 0.8716 to 0.8468 while keeping the unlooped CED's 8 KB of global KV per token; the paper reports recovering 86-93% of a looped Transformer's gain with 1/6 of its global KV.
headline.zh: 150M 规模下，encoder 循环把 BPB 从 0.8716 降到 0.8468，每 token 全局 KV 仍是不循环 CED 的 8 KB；论文称用 1/6 的全局 KV 拿回了循环 Transformer 86-93% 的收益。

results.setting: 150M non-embedding params, 6.0B tokens, FineWeb-Edu, 2048 context, T=8 at evaluation
150M, 29.6B tokens
150M, 6.0B tokens, exact fp32 token-by-token decoding at T=8
results.metric: BPB with last-round KV minus BPB with per-round KV

results.setting: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (552B) looped for 8 rounds on 4x GB200, serving only (no loop training)
results.metric: KV per token and 128K-token requests that fit

values.Looped CED (last-round KV): 36.8x less KV per token, fits 38 requests

findings.en: Running 12 or 16 rounds instead of the trained mean of 8 lowers BPB by at most 0.0004 and never raises it.
findings.zh: 推理时跑 12 或 16 遍（训练均值是 8 遍），BPB 最多降 0.0004，从不变差。

findings.en: After 5x longer training (29.6B tokens) the decoder loop still captures only 38% of the encoder loop's improvement.
findings.zh: 训练加长到 5 倍（29.6B token）后，decoder 循环的收益仍只有 encoder 循环的 38%。

tldr.en: Loop the CED encoder layers that produce global KV, train with random depth, and keep only the last round's KV.
tldr.zh: 循环产出全局 KV 的 CED encoder 层，随机遍数训练，推理只存最后一遍的 KV。

problem.en: When every round caches its own KV, a looped model's KV cache grows with the number of rounds, which cancels the memory advantage of KV-sparse layouts such as the causal encoder-decoder.
problem.zh: 如果每一遍都存自己的 KV，循环模型的 KV 会随遍数增长，抵消掉 CED 这类稀疏 KV 布局的显存优势。

en: Loop layers L2-5 of the encoder, which contain its only global KV source, for 8 rounds with Parcae's gated input injection.
Sample the number of rounds per sequence from max(1, Poisson(8)) and backpropagate through the last 4, so the core settles into a fixed point.
At inference, past tokens keep only their last-round KV, so the resident KV equals the unlooped CED's.
zh: 循环 encoder 的 L2-5（含 encoder 唯一的全局 KV 源），跑 8 遍，用 Parcae 的门控输入注入。
每条序列的遍数从 max(1, Poisson(8)) 采样，只反传最后 4 遍，让循环块收敛到不动点。
推理时历史 token 只保留最后一遍的 KV，常驻 KV 和不循环的 CED 一样。

en: Training experiments use 12-layer dense-FFN models up to 340M non-embedding parameters at 2K context; the 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash runs measure serving cost only, with no loop training.
Parameters, tokens and KV are held fixed but compute is not; a looped model runs 40 layer passes per decoded token instead of 12.
All runs share one hyperparameter set (Table 8); the baselines were not tuned separately.
The encoder loop puts every round on the prefill path; in the 552B serving test, prefill cost per prompt token at T=8 is 5.12x the unlooped CED (Table 13).
zh: 训练实验是 12 层 dense FFN 模型，最大 340M 非 embedding 参数，2K 上下文；552B 的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 只测服务成本，没训练过循环。
对齐了参数、token 和 KV，没对齐算力：循环模型每解码一个 token 执行 40 层，不循环是 12 层。
所有实验共用一套超参（Table 8），基线没有单独调。
encoder 循环让每一遍都进入 prefill；552B 服务测试里，T=8 时每个 prompt token 的 prefill 成本是不循环 CED 的 5.12 倍（Table 13）。

papers.title: One Block Is Enough: LoopMR for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction

tldr.en: Reuses one Restormer block at every iteration of unrolled MRI reconstruction and beats PromptMR+ with about 1/9 of its parameters; shared transformer blocks match or beat distinct-weight ones, while shared CNN blocks do worse.
tldr.zh: 在展开式 MRI 重建中每次迭代复用同一个 Restormer 块，参数量约为 PromptMR+ 的 1/9 而效果更好；共享的 Transformer 块与独立权重版本持平或更好，共享的 CNN 块则更差。

papers.title: Rectified Looped Transformer

tldr.en: Feeds each loop a linear interpolation between the current state and the block's prediction; at matched depth this lowers perplexity versus a standard looped Transformer and keeps hidden-state norms more stable, with no extra parameters.
tldr.zh: 把下一遍循环的输入改为当前状态与本遍预测之间的线性插值；在相同深度下，困惑度低于标准循环 Transformer，隐状态范数更稳定，且不增加参数。

papers.title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models

tldr.en: CRAM, a learned Hopfield-Tank energy minimized at inference, solves 99.996% of Sudoku-Extreme and 100% of Maze-Unique test puzzles with training at least 1,000x faster than looped models; the authors call these benchmarks trivially solvable.
tldr.zh: CRAM 是可学习的 Hopfield-Tank 能量函数，推理时沿能量下降求解；它解出 Sudoku-Extreme 99.996% 和 Maze-Unique 100% 的测试题，训练至少比循环模型快 1,000 倍；作者认为这类基准可以被轻易解决。

papers.title: Folding Language Models into Themselves

tldr.en: Concertina folds every N adjacent teacher layers into one shared block run N times with low-rank corrections; distilled from Qwen3-4B on 22B tokens, a 2.27B model retains 84% of the teacher averaged over eight benchmarks.
tldr.zh: Concertina 把教师模型每 N 个相邻层折叠成一个执行 N 次的共享块，并加低秩修正；从 Qwen3-4B 用 22B token 蒸馏出的 2.27B 模型在八个基准上平均保留教师 84% 的能力。

papers.title: ARC-VLN: Adaptive Recursive Computing-based Visual-Language Navigation

tldr.en: ARC-VLN runs a shared-parameter language backbone recursively for aerial VLN, letting only visual tokens exit early; on OpenFly it has the lowest navigation error of the compared methods and reduces FLOPs and GPU memory.
tldr.zh: ARC-VLN 在共享参数的语言骨干上做递归计算来完成空中视觉语言导航，只让视觉 token 提前退出；在 OpenFly 上，它的导航误差在对比方法中最低，并减少了 FLOPs 和显存占用。

papers.title: Wireless Edge-Assisted Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Physical AI

tldr.en: Uses constrained deep RL (TRPO-Lag) to jointly choose local or edge execution and the latent-reasoning convergence threshold of a recurrent-depth VLA, reaching up to 23% higher feasibility-weighted task success than benchmark constrained RL methods.
tldr.zh: 用约束深度强化学习（TRPO-Lag）为循环深度 VLA 联合选择本地或边缘执行以及隐式推理的收敛阈值，可行性加权任务成功率比基准约束强化学习方法最多高 23%。

papers.title: Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models

tldr.en: Studies how to cut decoding KV memory in depth-recurrent LMs: looped hybrids need frequent attention anchors, and training with recurrent KV replay lets iterations share KV states with performance close to separate per-iteration caches.
tldr.zh: 研究如何降低深度循环语言模型 decode 时的 KV 显存：looped hybrid 需要足够频繁的注意力锚点；用 recurrent KV replay 训练后，多个迭代可共享 KV 状态，性能接近每个迭代单独存 KV 的做法。

papers.title: LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: A training-free speculative decoding method for looped LLMs that puts multi-token suffix drafts and shallow-loop predictions in one draft tree; average speedup over greedy decoding is 5.85x on Ouro-2.6B and 5.13x on Huginn-3.5B.
tldr.zh: 面向循环 LLM 的免训练投机解码方法，把多 token 后缀草稿和浅层循环预测放进同一棵草稿树；相对贪心解码的平均加速在 Ouro-2.6B 上为 5.85x，在 Huginn-3.5B 上为 5.13x。

papers.title: When Does Reusing Layers Help Multimodal Embeddings?

tldr.en: Tests eleven loop designs for multimodal embeddings, proving that under forward-only attention repeated layers cannot make earlier image states query-dependent; on MMEB-V2 an added loop loses 0.46 points, while native recurrence gains +4.23 points.
tldr.zh: 在多模态 embedding 上测试十一种循环设计，证明在只向前传递信息的注意力下，重复层无法让排在 query 之前的图像状态依赖 query；在 MMEB-V2 上，新增循环下降 0.46 分，原生循环提升 +4.23 分。

papers.title: LoopSkim: Lossless Multi-Depth Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Proposes lossless speculative decoding for looped LMs in which each loop's readout checks draft tokens copied from the context and only full-depth readouts commit; without training, its speedup averages 1.73x that of LoopSpec.
tldr.zh: 为循环语言模型提出无损投机解码：从上下文复制的草稿 token 在每一遍循环的读出处接受检查，只有完整深度的读出才提交 token；无需训练时，其加速平均为 LoopSpec 的 1.73x。

papers.title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier

tldr.en: Tests latent feedback, which feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input, against compute-matched multi-epoch Transformers; it saves at most 48% of the compute and 47% of the unique data.
tldr.zh: 把每个 token 的顶层状态送入下一个 token 输入的 latent feedback，与用同等算力多训几个 epoch 的 Transformer 对比；latent feedback 最多省下 48% 的算力和 47% 的不重复数据。

papers.title: Efficient Multi-View Generation with Iterative Global-Local Proxy Attention

tldr.en: GLPA sends cross-view information in multi-view diffusion through compact proxies and refines them by reusing the same attention parameters within a denoising step; on FLUX, attention runs 2.65× faster than dense attention and reconstruction improves.
tldr.zh: GLPA 在多视角扩散中通过紧凑的代理 token 交换跨视角信息，并在单个去噪步内复用同一组注意力参数迭代细化代理；在 FLUX 上，注意力计算比稠密注意力快 2.65×，重建质量也有提升。

papers.title: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating

tldr.en: Distils an event-camera 3D model from the RGB teacher Déjà View, which repeatedly applies one shared transformer block, and gates that block by event density; it has the lowest pointmap error among evaluated event-based methods.
tldr.zh: 从 RGB 教师模型 Déjà View（反复应用同一个共享 transformer block）蒸馏出事件相机 3D 模型，并按事件密度调整该 block 的门控；在所评测的事件相机方法中点图误差最低。

papers.title: Latent Fact Composition under Next-Token Training

tldr.en: Baton looped transformers pass the intermediate entity to the second loop as a token embedding; trained only on answers, two variants almost solve held-out two-hop questions, but next-token training makes accuracy rise then decline.
tldr.zh: Baton 循环 Transformer 把中间实体作为 token embedding 传给第二遍循环；只用答案训练时，三个变体中的两个几乎全部答对留出的两跳问题，但改用 next-token 训练后准确率先升后降。

papers.title: InfuseLoop: Cross-Trajectory Latent Injection for Scalable Parallel Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Adds cross-trajectory latent injection to Parallel Looped Transformers, so each loop aggregates causally available hidden states from later trajectories via attention residuals; this eliminates training-loss spikes and improves validation-loss scaling up to eight loops.
tldr.zh: 为并行循环 Transformer（PLT）加入跨轨迹隐状态注入，让每个循环通过注意力残差汇聚后续轨迹中因果可用的隐状态；该方法消除了训练损失尖峰，并改善了最多八个循环时验证损失的 scaling。

papers.title: LoopZip: Visual Token Compression for Efficient Looped Vision-Language Models

tldr.en: LoopZip compresses visual tokens in looped vision-language models without training, selecting tokens by attention from two calls of the same shared layer; on LoopVL-1B it keeps 97.16% of the original performance at 50% pruning ratio.
tldr.zh: LoopZip 无需训练即可压缩循环视觉语言模型中的视觉 token，依据同一共享层两次调用的注意力选择 token；在 LoopVL-1B 上以 50% 剪枝率保留原模型 97.16% 的性能。

papers.title: Proximal Targets: Training Looped Refiners on Problems with Many Correct Answers

tldr.en: Proves that a single stored target sets a loss floor for looped refiners (HRM, TRM) on puzzles with many answers; training each pass toward the nearest correct answer solves 98.8% of multi-answer Sudoku versus 2.5%.
tldr.zh: 证明在有多个正确答案的谜题上，HRM、TRM 等循环精炼器朝单一存储答案训练会留下任何模型容量都消除不了的损失下限；改为让每一遍朝离自身输入最近的正确答案训练后，多解 Sudoku 的求解率为 98.8%，标准目标为 2.5%。

papers.title: Simpler Tiny Recursive Models

tldr.en: STRM simplifies TRM to a single uniformly updated state, using jittered-rate exponential moving updates and slow-channel readout; under TRM's data, parameters and compute it gains 3.8 points on Sudoku-Extreme and matches TRM on Maze-Hard.
tldr.zh: STRM 把 TRM 简化为单一状态和统一更新，状态采用训练时速率抖动的指数滑动更新，只从慢速更新的通道读出解；在与 TRM 相同的数据、参数和算力下，Sudoku-Extreme 提高 3.8 分，Maze-Hard 与 TRM 持平。

papers.title: LoopCache: Accelerating Long-Context Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Proposes LoopCache, self-speculative decoding for long-context looped Transformers that updates drafts across intermediate loops by confidence and rotates loop-specific KV caches; reports average 10.25x and 14.56x speedup over WFD and LoopSpec.
tldr.zh: 提出 LoopCache，一种面向长上下文循环 Transformer 的自推测解码方法，按置信度在各中间循环更新草稿，并轮流使用各循环的 KV cache；相对 WFD 和 LoopSpec 平均加速 10.25x 和 14.56x。

papers.title: Late Entry in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Late entry lets new tokens in looped language models skip early passes and run only the final passes over a deep context cache, outperforming matched early exit; Wake verification reaches 5.2x greedy-exact speedup on Ouro-2.6B.
tldr.zh: Late entry 让循环语言模型中的新 token 跳过前几遍、只在深层上下文缓存上运行最后几遍，优于匹配的 early exit；Wake 验证在 Ouro-2.6B 上达到 5.2x 的 greedy-exact 加速。

papers.title: Fold the Loop: Decoding-Time KV Memory for Looped Vision-Language Models

tldr.en: FoldCache lets groups of recurrent steps in a looped VLM share the group's final visual KV during decoding; on LoopVL it approximately halves prefix KV memory while matching full-cache accuracy on five open-ended benchmarks.
tldr.zh: FoldCache 让循环 VLM 中同一组循环步在 decode 时共享该组最后一步的视觉 KV；在 LoopVL 上，prefix KV 显存约减半，五个开放式基准上的准确率与完整 cache 持平。

papers.title: LoopedWAM: Looped World Action Models for Elastic Inference

tldr.en: LoopedWAM loops a shared six-block core in each expert of a robot world action model, and elastic self-distillation lets one checkpoint serve several action-depth and sampling-step budgets; it reaches 96.1% success on LIBERO.
tldr.zh: LoopedWAM 在机器人世界动作模型的每个专家里循环一个由六个 block 组成的共享核心，并用弹性自蒸馏让单个 checkpoint 适配多种动作深度和采样步数预算，在 LIBERO 上成功率为 96.1%。

papers.title: dLoop: Looped Diffusion Language Models via Recurrent Latent Refinement

tldr.en: Restructures a pretrained diffusion language model into a Prelude-Loop-Coda design that reapplies a shared middle block before tokens are committed, reaching the highest or tied-highest accuracy on GSM8K, MATH, MBPP and HumanEval.
tldr.zh: 将预训练扩散语言模型改造为 Prelude-Loop-Coda 结构，在提交 token 之前重复执行共享的中间块，在 GSM8K、MATH、MBPP 和 HumanEval 上均取得最高或并列最高的准确率。

papers.title: GLiDE: A Fast, Calibrated Decision Model Distilled from Reasoning Teachers

tldr.en: Converts Qwen hybrid LMs into single-pass decision models via bidirectional full attention and multi-teacher distillation; checkpoint averaging plus parameter-free recurrent depth (reapplying middle layers) raises the 27B hidden-set score from 71.52 to 73.37.
tldr.zh: 把 Qwen 混合架构语言模型改造成单次前向的决策模型，做法是让全注意力层变为双向并做多教师蒸馏；再加上 checkpoint 平均和无参数的循环深度（重复执行中间层），27B 模型的隐藏集得分从 71.52 提高到 73.37。

papers.title: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology

tldr.en: Puts learnable scalar gates on every sublayer of standard and looped Transformers so training removes the unneeded ones; carved models reach lower validation loss than dense models trained with up to 1.7 times more compute.
tldr.zh: 在标准与循环 Transformer 的每个子层上加可学习的标量门控，让训练自行删去不需要的子层；裁出的模型验证损失低于用多至 1.7 倍算力训练的稠密模型。

papers.title: Introducing Inkling 2 Mini

note.en: Inkling 2 Mini has 24 MoE layers (8 of 128 experts per token) in four six-layer blocks; the two middle blocks share weights and run three times, so 24 stored layers give 48 layer applications per token. Per the Hugging Face blog, each block has five sliding-window layers (1,024-token window) and one full-attention layer, and each layer visit keeps its own KV. Every pass starts from the prelude output; passes 2 and 3 also read the previous pass's middle-block outputs (the message) through attention residuals, admitted by a learned gate that starts fully closed. Labels are 0-indexed as in the Hugging Face blog; the post numbers the same core 7-18. The released research twin TML-d24-varloop-research has the same layout but was trained with 1 to 5 passes and is run at up to 10 in the post.
note.zh: Inkling 2 Mini 有 24 层 MoE（每 token 从 128 个专家中选 8 个），分成四个 6 层块；中间两块共享权重、跑三遍，24 层存储权重每 token 执行 48 次层计算。据 Hugging Face 博客，每块有五层滑窗注意力（窗口 1,024 token）和一层全注意力，每次层访问各存一份 KV。每一遍都从 prelude 输出开始；第 2、3 遍还通过 attention residuals 读取上一遍中间块的输出（称为 message），由一个初始完全关闭的可学习门控接入。层号按 Hugging Face 博客从 0 开始，原文把同一段 core 记作 7-18。同时发布的研究版 TML-d24-varloop-research 结构相同，但训练时用 1 到 5 遍，文中最多跑到 10 遍。

baseline.en: A scaling-ladder run that loops the last 12 layers (13-24) instead of the middle 12 (7-18), with the same three passes and equal training compute; both runs' gains are expressed as the compute a no-loop baseline would need to match their loss.
baseline.zh: scaling ladder 上的对照：循环最后 12 层（13-24）而不是中间 12 层（7-18），同样跑三遍、训练算力相同；两者的收益都用无循环基线追平其 loss 所需的算力来表示。

headline.en: Looping the middle 12 layers gave larger accuracy gains than looping the last 12 on 27 of 28 evaluations; at training step 2,000 a no-loop baseline was estimated to need 1.51-1.91x the compute to match the middle loop's loss, against 1.24-1.36x for the last loop.
headline.zh: 28 项评测中有 27 项，循环中间 12 层的准确率收益大于循环最后 12 层；训练到第 2,000 步时，估计无循环基线需要 1.51-1.91 倍算力才能追平中间循环的 loss，追平最后 12 层循环只需 1.24-1.36 倍。

findings.en: On the scaling ladder, an unpruned non-looping model cost 7.5% less compute to train than the unpruned looped version but needed 140% more inference compute to match its loss on 512k-token agentic traces.
findings.zh: 在 scaling ladder 上，未剪枝的不循环模型训练算力比未剪枝的循环版少 7.5%，但要在 512k token 的 agentic 轨迹上追平循环版的 loss，推理算力要多 140%。

findings.en: TML-d24-varloop-research was never trained with more than five passes, yet running it with ten does not significantly degrade its no-CoT time horizon (40 s, against 42 s at five), and on N-Hop Lookup it follows longer chains with more passes, improving out to ten loops.
findings.zh: TML-d24-varloop-research 训练时从未超过 5 遍，但跑 10 遍时 no-CoT 时间跨度没有明显下降（40 秒，5 遍时为 42 秒）；在 N-Hop Lookup 上，遍数越多能跟的查找链越长，一直提升到 10 遍。
findings.ref: No-CoT capabilities; figures "No-CoT time horizons" and "N-Hop Lookup"

findings.en: With CoT, more passes mainly help multi-hop reasoning rather than recall: gains are largest on long-context retrieval (MRCR), then math and science reasoning, then long-horizon agentic tasks, while knowledge-intensive benchmarks (AA-Omniscience, SimpleQA Verified, SimpleVQA, WorldVQA) do not improve with more passes.
findings.zh: 有 CoT 时，增加遍数主要帮助多跳推理而不是记忆：长上下文检索（MRCR）收益最大，其次是数学和科学推理，再次是长程 agentic 任务；AA-Omniscience、SimpleQA Verified、SimpleVQA、WorldVQA 这类知识密集型评测不随遍数提升。

findings.en: Accuracy at each reasoning-token budget generally rises with passes, with diminishing returns after 3; on GPQA Diamond questions solved at all pass counts, reasoning at 5 passes averages 1,661 tokens against 3,703 at 1 pass, with unchanged sentence length and dictionary-word share.
findings.zh: 每个推理 token 预算下的准确率一般随遍数上升，3 遍之后收益递减；在各遍数都答对的 GPQA Diamond 题上，5 遍的推理平均 1,661 token，1 遍为 3,703 token，句长和词典词比例不变。

findings.en: Among CoTs of 750-1,250 tokens, Inkling 2 Mini and the variable-loop model at 3 passes follow a CoT instruction at most 0.1% of the time (Qwen3.8-27B 1.3%), too rarely to separate loop counts; LinuxArena stealth rates show no clear trend with the number of passes.
findings.zh: 在 750-1,250 token 的 CoT 中，Inkling 2 Mini 和 3 遍的可变循环模型最多只有 0.1% 的时候遵守 CoT 指令（Qwen3.8-27B 为 1.3%），低到无法区分不同遍数；LinuxArena 的 stealth rate 也看不出随遍数变化的明显趋势。

tldr.en: Open-weight MoE (26.4B total, 3.4B active) that runs the middle 12 of its 24 layers three times with shared weights, released with a variable-loop research twin used to measure how pass count affects capability and CoT monitorability.
tldr.zh: 开源权重的 MoE（总参数 26.4B、激活 3.4B），24 层中的中间 12 层共享权重跑三遍；同时发布一个可变循环的研究版，用来测遍数对能力和 CoT 可监控性的影响。

problem.en: Looping lets a model do more serial computation per token without adding parameters, which has raised concerns that looped models are harder to oversee by reading their chain of thought; the post reports what looping gives a small open model and how pass count affects CoT monitorability.
problem.zh: 循环让模型不增加参数就能在每个 token 上做更多串行计算，这引起了一种担忧：循环模型更难通过阅读 CoT 来监督。本文报告循环给一个小型开源模型带来的收益，以及遍数如何影响 CoT 可监控性。

en: 24 MoE layers (8 of 128 experts per token) in four six-layer blocks; the two middle blocks share weights and run three times, giving 48 layer applications per token from 24 stored layers.

Every pass starts from the prelude output; passes 2 and 3 also read the previous pass's middle-block outputs (the message) through attention residuals, and a learned gate that initially blocks the message lets looping be introduced stably during training.

Training started with 8 of 384 experts per token; two-thirds of the experts were pruned at one point in midtraining (keeping the 128 most used per layer), followed by 1T tokens distilled from a larger internal Inkling model, SFT, and RL totaling 2.2T tokens over 2,000 steps. Expert layers use NVFP4 on all forward passes and the last four layers use MXFP8.

A variable-loop research model, TML-d24-varloop-research, was trained with 1 to 5 passes (sampled 1:2:6:2:1 for the rest of midtraining, post-trained at 3) and is run at 1 to 5 passes, and at 10 in the no-CoT tests, to measure capability and CoT monitorability.
zh: 24 层 MoE（每 token 从 128 个专家中选 8 个），分成四个 6 层块；中间两块共享权重、跑三遍，24 层存储权重每 token 执行 48 次层计算。
每一遍都从 prelude 输出开始；第 2、3 遍还通过 attention residuals 读取上一遍中间块的输出（message），一个初始完全挡住 message 的可学习门控让训练中可以稳定地引入循环。
训练开始时每 token 从 384 个专家中选 8 个；midtraining 中某一时刻剪掉三分之二的专家（每层保留最常用的 128 个），之后用 1T token 从更大的内部 Inkling 模型蒸馏，再做 SFT 和共 2.2T token、2,000 步的 RL。专家层的所有前向都用 NVFP4，最后四层用 MXFP8。
可变循环研究版 TML-d24-varloop-research 用 1 到 5 遍训练（midtraining 后段按 1:2:6:2:1 采样，post-training 用 3 遍），评测时跑 1 到 5 遍、no-CoT 测试还跑 10 遍，用来测能力和 CoT 可监控性。

en: Inkling 2 Mini supports only a fixed number of passes (3), so every pass-count comparison uses TML-d24-varloop-research, whose later training stages differ; its model card cautions against comparing it directly with Inkling 2 Mini.

Three passes dominated the variable-loop model's training and its RL used 3 passes only; the authors say results at other pass counts may understate what dedicated training could achieve and do not show what RL at a higher pass count would learn.

The loop-placement and looping-versus-non-looping comparisons come from scaling-ladder runs (placement at training step 2,000; unpruned models for looping versus non-looping), not from the released model, and the post does not give the sizes of those runs.
No-CoT results use a subset of Think Fast tasks, with answers elicited by prefilling the start of the response; the models were not trained to answer without CoT.
LinuxArena used a helpful-only fine-tune of Inkling 2 Mini, a weaker monitor (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) and a subset of 184 task pairings.
Decoding speeds in the opening coding figure are theoretical ceilings (614 GB/s, BF16 weights, batch size one), evaluation setups vary by model, and the post gives no pretraining token count.
zh: Inkling 2 Mini 只支持固定遍数（3 遍），所有遍数对比都用 TML-d24-varloop-research，而它后期的训练阶段与 Inkling 2 Mini 不同；其 model card 提醒不要把两者直接比较。
可变循环模型的训练以 3 遍为主，RL 也只用 3 遍；作者说其他遍数的结果可能低估专门训练能达到的水平，也说明不了在更多遍数上做 RL 会学到什么。
循环位置对比和循环与不循环的对比都来自 scaling ladder 实验（位置对比在第 2,000 训练步；循环与不循环对比用未剪枝模型），不是发布的模型，文中也没给这些实验的模型规模。
no-CoT 结果只用了 Think Fast 的部分任务，通过预填回答开头让模型直接作答；这些模型没有为不用 CoT 作答而训练。
LinuxArena 用的是 Inkling 2 Mini 的 helpful-only 微调版、较弱的监控模型（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B），以及 184 组任务的子集。
开篇编码图里的解码速度是理论上限（614 GB/s、BF16 权重、batch size 1），各模型评测设置不同，文中也没给预训练 token 数。

papers.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer

note.en: GLM-5.4 loops 28 layers of the GLM-5 base model for two iterations; the post describes them as middle layers but does not give the base model's layer count or which 28 layers are looped. The loop was added to the already pre-trained base through continued training at the 750B scale.
note.zh: GLM-5.4 把 GLM-5 基座的 28 层循环两遍；文中说这些是中间层，但没有给出基座的总层数，也没说具体是哪 28 层。循环是在已经预训练好的 750B 规模基座上通过继续训练加进去的。

baseline.en: A 30B model with the same architecture as the 750B base, without the loop, evaluated after 200K long-context SFT with thinking mode enabled.
baseline.zh: 与 750B 基座同架构、不循环的 30B 模型，在 200K 长上下文 SFT 之后开启 thinking 模式评测。

headline.en: With identical parameter counts and about 10% more total training compute, the looped 30B model improves AIME25 from 19.17 to 30.42 and GPQA-Diamond from 47.58 to 56.26, while average output length drops by 10-14% on most benchmarks.
headline.zh: 参数量相同、总训练算力只多约 10% 时，循环版 30B 模型的 AIME25 从 19.17 升到 30.42，GPQA-Diamond 从 47.58 升到 56.26；多数基准上的平均输出长度缩短 10-14%。

findings.en: Converting middle layers of a pre-trained model into a loop by directly overwriting hidden states makes activation norms blow up across iterations; per-token gates for each iteration fix this, with the first pass writing conservatively and the second pass opening the gates, and harder tokens getting larger first-pass writes.
findings.zh: 把预训练模型的中间层改成循环时，如果直接覆盖隐状态，激活范数会随迭代爆炸；为每次迭代加独立的逐 token 门控可以解决：第一遍写入较保守，第二遍放开门控，难的 token 第一遍写得更多。

findings.en: The second loop reuses the sparse KV selected in the first pass and keeps only its own new KV in a sliding window, so an extra loop costs one sliding window of KV rather than a full context cache.
findings.zh: 第二遍复用第一遍选出的稀疏 KV，自己新生成的 KV 只保留一个滑窗，所以多一遍只多一个滑窗的 KV，而不是一整份上下文缓存。
findings.ref: Hybrid KV Cache (Global Sharing + Independent Sliding Window)

findings.en: Reusing the first loop's sparse-attention indices in the second loop performs nearly identically to recomputing them on every pass.
findings.zh: 第二遍直接复用第一遍稀疏注意力的索引，效果与每遍重新计算索引几乎相同。

findings.en: The authors state that looped models trained from scratch still lag behind unshared models under the same pre-training compute budget, which is why they adapted a pre-trained base through continued training instead.
findings.zh: 作者称，从头训练的循环模型在相同预训练算力下仍不如不共享权重的模型，所以改为在预训练好的基座上继续训练出循环结构。
findings.ref: From Pre-Trained Base to Loop Transformer

tldr.en: Z.ai turns 28 layers of its pre-trained GLM-5 base into a two-pass loop through continued training at the 750B scale, with per-token gates, a shared-plus-sliding-window KV cache and reused sparse-attention indices.
tldr.zh: Z.ai 通过继续训练，把已预训练的 GLM-5 基座中的 28 层改成跑两遍的循环（750B 规模），配合逐 token 门控、共享加滑窗的 KV cache 和复用的稀疏注意力索引。

problem.en: Long-chain tasks such as large-scale software engineering, 3D modeling and physical control need more effective compute per token, but looped models trained from scratch lag behind unshared models at the same pre-training compute.
problem.zh: 大规模软件工程、3D 建模、物理控制等长链条任务需要每个 token 更多的有效计算，但从头训练的循环模型在相同预训练算力下不如不共享权重的模型。

en: Adapt the pre-trained GLM-5 base into a Loop Transformer by continued training, running 28 weight-shared layers for two iterations.
Add independent per-token gates for each iteration that write candidate updates back into the residual stream, so activation norms stay stable.
Let the second loop reuse the first pass's sparse KV and attention indices plus its own sliding-window KV, and fuse kernels to cut intermediate memory traffic.
zh: 在预训练好的 GLM-5 基座上继续训练，改成 Loop Transformer：28 层共享权重的层跑两遍。
每次迭代加独立的逐 token 门控，按比例把候选更新写回残差流，让激活范数保持稳定。
第二遍复用第一遍的稀疏 KV 和注意力索引，外加自己的滑窗 KV；系统层面融合算子，减少中间结果的显存读写。

en: This is a blog post, not a paper; the base model's layer count, which 28 layers are looped, the training tokens and the evaluation details beyond the table are not given.

The controlled comparison is iso-parameter, not iso-compute (the looped 30B model used about 10% more total training compute), and it is reported only at 30B after long-context SFT; the 750B results are not shown as a controlled comparison.
The claim that GLM-5.4 reaches intelligence levels comparable to 2T-3T parameter models comes without a stated evaluation protocol in the post.
The authors note that the model tends to get caught in overly long "marathon thinking" loops.
Weights are not released yet (planned after safety hardening) and the API is listed as coming soon.
zh: 这是一篇博客而不是论文；基座总层数、循环的是哪 28 层、训练 token 数，以及表格之外的评测细节都没有给出。
对照只对齐了参数，没有对齐算力（循环版 30B 多用了约 10% 的总训练算力），而且只在 30B、长上下文 SFT 之后报告；750B 没有给出受控对比。
文中称 GLM-5.4 达到 2T-3T 参数模型的水平，但没有说明评测方法。
作者提到模型容易陷入过长的「马拉松式思考」。
权重尚未发布（计划在安全加固后开源），API 标注为即将推出。

en: How to make compute adaptive so that harder tokens get more iterations.
How the returns of looping behave as both loop count and model size keep growing.
zh: 如何做到自适应计算，让更难的 token 自动获得更多迭代。
循环次数和模型规模同时继续增大时，循环的收益会怎样变化。
